programme.title: Custody
programme.desc: Constable Siva escorts a witness to court, but learns the entire police department plans the witness's murder, forcing him to go rogue and protect truth.

programme.title: Lamhe
programme.desc: Viren falls for Pallavi, but she marries Siddharth. The couple dies, leaving behind their daughter, who grows up to look just like her mother and falls in love with Viren. Release Year: 1991 Director: Yash Chopra Awards: Filmfare Awards- Best Film - Yash Chopra, Best Story - Honey Irani, Best Dialogue - Rahi Masoom Raza, Best Costume Design - Neeta Lulla.

programme.title: Kyo Kii Main Jhuth Nahi Bolta
programme.desc: Raj is a lawyer who finds great success through his habit of lying. However, when his son wishes for his father to stop lying, Raj is magically forced to speak the truth and gets into trouble. Release Year: 2001 Director: David Dhawan.

programme.title: Housefull 2
programme.desc: The hunt for the richest son-in-law leads to complete chaos with every prospective groom pretending to be the richest. Release Year: 2012 Director: Sajid Khan Awards: Zee Cine Awards- Power Club - Box Office Award- Sajid Khan. Stardust Awards- Star of the Year - Male- Akshay Kumar, People's Choice Awards- Favorite Comedy Movie, Favorite Comedy Movie Star.

programme.title: Shershaah
programme.desc: 'Shershaah' tells the tale of Captain Vikram Batra, a brave Indian soldier. He showed great courage fighting in the Kargil War of 1999. His actions helped India win. Release Year: 2021 Director: Vishnuvardhan Awards: 67th Filmfare Awards, 69th National Film Awards.

programme.title: War 2
programme.desc: Working as a mercenary, Kabir accepts a high-risk mission for a criminal network. But soon, his task pits him against his unflinching former ally. Release Year: 2025 Director: Ayan Mukerji.

programme.title: Total Siyapaa
programme.desc: Aman, a Pakistani man living in London, falls in love with Asha, an Indian woman. But he must convince her parents to let them get married, despite their different nationalities. Release Year: 2014 Director: Eeshwar Nivas Awards: 2005 Winner Special Award - Ramesh Sippy - Best film in the last 50 years of Indian cinema.

programme.title: Lucky-No Time For Love
programme.desc: Lucky is molested by a Russian boy on her way to school but she escapes and hides in Aditya's car. When a terrorist attack breaks out, the two manage to escape and hide in an isolated graveyard. Release Year: 2005 Director: Radhika Rao, Vinay Sapru.

programme.title: Benaam Badsha
programme.desc: A young man abandoned by his parents at birth grows up to be a paid assassin who rapes Jyoti on her wedding day, ruining her life. However, she soon moves in with him and decides to reform him. Release Year: 1991 Director: K. Ravishankar.

programme.title: The Masterpiece
programme.desc: Defying his mother, Yuva dives into the underworld to become a local thug, but things get dangerous when a sudden clash with a drug lord ruins everything.

programme.title: Love Story 2050
programme.desc: With the help of his uncle, a man travels to the future to try and bring his girlfriend back to life. Release Year: 2008 Director: Harry Baweja Awards: Best Visual Effects: Ian McFadyen, John Dietz, Merzin Tavaria Filmfare Awards.

programme.title: Indoo Ki Jawani
programme.desc: After her debauchee boyfriend cheats on her, Indoo starts using dating apps to find the perfect partner. Things take a hilarious turn when she finds out that one of her dates is from Pakistan. Release Year: 2023 Director: Abir Sengupta.

programme.title: Tanu Weds Manu
programme.desc: Manu, an NRI doctor visiting India, falls for Tanu, a fun-loving girl who enlists his help to elope with her lover, leading to unexpected twists in their lives. Release Year: 2011 Director: Aanand L. Rai Awards: National Film Award - Best Supporting ActreSS: Kangana RanautInternational Indian Film Academy Awards IIFA - Best Music Director: Krsna SoloIIFA - Best Lyricist: Rajshekhar Stardust Awards - Best ActreSSETC Bollywood BusineSS Awards - Most Profitable Actor.

programme.title: Aiyaary
programme.desc: After Colonel Abhay Singh and his protege Jai Bakshi have a fallout, Jai goes rogue and threatens to bring down the government. So the mentor is forced to go after him. Release Year: 2018 Director: Neeraj Pandey.

programme.title: Pathaan
programme.desc: An Indian RAW agent named Pathaan discovers a planned attack on India led by a mercenary group, and must team up with an ally to stop them while facing numerous betrayals and destruction. Release Year: 2023 Director: Siddharth Anand Awards: 2023 Winner Nickelodeon Kids' Choice Award - Favorite Movie, 2023 Nominee IFF Award - Best Film.

programme.title: Chhaava
programme.desc: Shivaji's death sparks the Maratha-Mughal conflict. His son Sambhaji leads resistance against Aurangzeb's forces. Amid battles and intrigue, both sides face challenges in a struggle for power. Release Year: 2025 Director: Laxman Utekar.

programme.title: The President Is Coming
programme.desc: Six young contestants undergo bizarre tests and stop at nothing to top the list of the young faces responsible for shaping 'The New India' and eventually meet George Bush.

programme.title: Chandni Chowk To China
programme.desc: A simple cook is mistaken for the reincarnation of an ancient warrior Liu Shengh by residents of an oppressed Chinese village. Release Year: 2009 Director: Nikkhil Advani.

programme.title: Bloody Ishq
programme.desc: After a memory-erasing accident, Neha seeks refuge on a secluded Scottish island, unaware her husband conceals a terrifying secret that threatens their new life. Release Year: 2024 Director: Vikram Bhatt.

programme.title: Kuch Kuch Hota Hai
programme.desc: Anjali is very friendly with Rahul. Rahul falls in love with Tina and marries her. This breaks Anjali's heart and she decides to settle far away. Release Year: 1998 Director: Karan Johar Awards: 5 Filmfare Awards, National Film Awards, Screen Awards, 4 IIFA Awards.

programme.title: Fanaa
programme.desc: A blind Kashmiri girl travels without her parents for the first time with a dance troupe to Delhi to perform in a ceremony for Independence Day. Release Year: 2006 Director: Kunal Kohli Awards: Filmfare Awards- Best ActreSS- Kajol, Best Lyrics- Prasoon Joshi, Best Playback Singer - Shaan and Kailash Kher for the song Chaand sifarish.

programme.title: Badmaash Company
programme.desc: Karan, a middle-class graduate, is heartbroken when his mother sells her jewelry for his father's treatment. Determined to fix it, he hatches a plan to get rich fast, risking everything. Release Year: 2010 Director: Parmeet Sethi.

programme.title: Babli Bouncer
programme.desc: A one-of-a-kind story of a female bouncer, the film follows Babli Bouncer. It explores the various facets of the profession, which is usually dominated by men. Release Year: 2022 Director: Madhur Bhandarkar Awards: 2022 Winner Filmfare Award- Best Director and Best ActreSS Duo- Madhur Bhandarkar, Tamannaah Bhatia, 2023 Winner Special Award- Dynamic Director of the Year- Madhur Bhandarkar, 2022 Winner Popular AwardBreaking the Mould- Female- Tamannaah Bhatia.

programme.title: Kis Kisko Pyaar Karoon 2
programme.desc: A laugh-out-loud Bollywood comedy of tangled romances and mistaken identities, following a hapless hero juggling chaotic relationships in a riotous tale of love, lies and hilarious misadventures. Release Year: 2025 Director: Anukalp Goswami.

programme.title: Shivaay
programme.desc: A mountaineer, is forced to take the law into his hands when his daughter, Gaura Abigail, gets kidnapped by human traffickers in Bulgaria. Release Year: 2016 Director: Ajay Devgn.

programme.title: Abcd 2
programme.desc: Childhood friends Suresh and Vinnie, bound by their love for dance, form a crew and battle personal, financial, and competitive hurdles to chase their dream of performing in Las Vegas. Release Year: 2015 Director: Remo D'Souza.

programme.title: Dear Dad
programme.desc: A teenager and his father form a special bond with each other while on an unplanned road trip from their home in Delhi. Release Year: 2016 Director: Tanuj Bhramar.

programme.title: Aisha
programme.desc: Aisha, who loves playing matchmaker much to her friend Arjun's disapproval, finds a new target in the simple Shefali. But in the process, she ends up ruining her own relationship with close friends. Release Year: 2010 Director: Rajshree Ojha Awards: Stardust Award for Breakthrough Performance - Female Amrita Puri.

programme.title: Saamrajya
programme.desc: An undercover constable travels to Sri Lanka to dismantle a syndicate, only to find his estranged brother is the mastermind, forcing him to face loyalty, morals, and duty.

programme.title: Aavesham
programme.desc: Three engineering students arrive in Bangalore for their studies but soon get caught in a conflict. Struggling to handle the situation, they turn to a local gangster for help, risking everything.

programme.title: Deedar
programme.desc: As Anand and Sapna get engaged, their life takes a wrong turn, connected to their parents' past. This movie stars Akshay Kumar and Karishma Kapoor. Release Year: 1992 Director: Pramod Chakravorty.

programme.title: Ta Ra Rum Pum
programme.desc: Top-notch racer RV's life changes after his accident on the race track. Will he be able to regain his lost glory? Release Year: 2007 Director: Siddharth Anand.

programme.title: Luka Chupi
programme.desc: Reporter Guddu and Rashmi begin a live-in relationship after falling in love. However, their lives become complicated when their families assume they have run away together and create confusion. Release Year: 2019 Director: Laxman Utekar Awards: 2020 Winner Special Award - Star Plus Nayi Baat Award.

programme.desc: एक प्रतिभाशाली युवा शेफ मन्नत, बड़े सपने देखती है लेकिन उसकी नियोक्ता ऐश्वर्या के रूप में उसके सामने बड़ी बाधा आती है। दोनों अंजान है, कि ऐश्वर्या मन्नत की माँ भी है जिसने उसे जन्म के समय छोड़ा था।.

programme.title: ఓమి నెం.1
programme.sub-title: Omi, an ultra-rich nine-year-old heir, encounters hilarious and eye-opening situations that teach him about the realities of life
programme.desc: సంపన్న వారసుడైన తొమ్మిదేళ్ల ఓమి, జీవితంలో ఎదురయ్యే సరదా, ఆశ్చర్యకరమైన పరిస్థితుల ద్వారా జీవిత సత్యాలు తెలుసుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: బయోనిక్ మాక్స్
programme.sub-title: Max, a bionic guinea pig, and his goldfish best friend embark on fascinating adventures after they escape the laboratory and try to fit in the wildlife
programme.desc: పరిశోధనా కేంద్రం నుండి తప్పించుకుని బయటి ప్రపంచంలో అడుగుపెట్టిన మాక్స్, గోల్డ్ ఫిష్ లు అనేక సాహసాలు చేస్తారు.

programme.title: హంటర్ X హంటర్
programme.sub-title: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father
programme.desc: గాన్ ఫ్రీక్స్, అదృశ్యమైన తన తండ్రిని వెతకాలనే ఆశతో, అరుదైన రాక్షసులు, నిధిని వేటాడే హంటర్‌గా మారడానికి సిద్దమవుతాడు.

programme.title: వన్ పీస్
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: యువకుడు మంకీ డి లఫ్ఫీ, అతని సముద్రపు దొంగల బృందం ఒక కల్పిత నిధిని కనుగొనడానికి ఉత్తేజకరమైన సాహసయాత్రను ప్రారంభిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Mayumi Tanaka (Monkey D Luffy),Kazuya Nakai (Roronoa Zoro),Akemi Okamura (Nami),Kappei Yamaguchi (Usopp),Hiroaki Hirata (Sanji),Mahito Ôba

programme.title: కిటెరెట్సు
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: ప్రాథమిక పాఠశాల విద్యార్థి కిటెరెట్సు, అతని రోబోట్ కొరోసుకే తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి వివిధ సాహసాలలో పాల్గొంటారు.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: వీ బేర్ బేర్స్
programme.sub-title: Three brother bears, Grizzly, Panda, and Ice, awkwardly navigate life in the San Francisco Bay Area as they try to fit into modern human society
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్లీ, పాండా, ఐస్ లు ఆధునిక మానవ జీవితాన్ని గడిపే క్రమంలో శాన్ ఫ్రాన్సిస్కో బే ఏరియాలో ఇబ్బందులు ఎదుర్కొంటారు.

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.title: ఓమి నెం.1
programme.sub-title: Omi, an ultra-rich nine-year-old heir, encounters hilarious and eye-opening situations that teach him about the realities of life
programme.desc: సంపన్న వారసుడైన తొమ్మిదేళ్ల ఓమి, జీవితంలో ఎదురయ్యే సరదా, ఆశ్చర్యకరమైన పరిస్థితుల ద్వారా జీవిత సత్యాలు తెలుసుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: బయోనిక్ మాక్స్
programme.sub-title: Max, a bionic guinea pig, and his goldfish best friend embark on fascinating adventures after they escape the laboratory and try to fit in the wildlife
programme.desc: పరిశోధనా కేంద్రం నుండి తప్పించుకుని బయటి ప్రపంచంలో అడుగుపెట్టిన మాక్స్, గోల్డ్ ఫిష్ లు అనేక సాహసాలు చేస్తారు.

programme.title: హంటర్ X హంటర్
programme.sub-title: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father
programme.desc: గాన్ ఫ్రీక్స్, అదృశ్యమైన తన తండ్రిని వెతకాలనే ఆశతో, అరుదైన రాక్షసులు, నిధిని వేటాడే హంటర్‌గా మారడానికి సిద్దమవుతాడు.

programme.title: వన్ పీస్
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: యువకుడు మంకీ డి లఫ్ఫీ, అతని సముద్రపు దొంగల బృందం ఒక కల్పిత నిధిని కనుగొనడానికి ఉత్తేజకరమైన సాహసయాత్రను ప్రారంభిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Mayumi Tanaka (Monkey D Luffy),Kazuya Nakai (Roronoa Zoro),Akemi Okamura (Nami),Kappei Yamaguchi (Usopp),Hiroaki Hirata (Sanji),Mahito Ôba

programme.title: కిటెరెట్సు
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: ప్రాథమిక పాఠశాల విద్యార్థి కిటెరెట్సు, అతని రోబోట్ కొరోసుకే తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి వివిధ సాహసాలలో పాల్గొంటారు.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: వీ బేర్ బేర్స్
programme.sub-title: Three brother bears, Grizzly, Panda, and Ice, awkwardly navigate life in the San Francisco Bay Area as they try to fit into modern human society
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్లీ, పాండా, ఐస్ లు ఆధునిక మానవ జీవితాన్ని గడిపే క్రమంలో శాన్ ఫ్రాన్సిస్కో బే ఏరియాలో ఇబ్బందులు ఎదుర్కొంటారు.

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.title: पूज्या दीदी मां ऋतंभराजी
programme.sub-title: A religious leader delivers an enlightening discourse on the holy scriptures and encourages devotees to live a spiritual life
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथ-प्रदर्शक पवित्र शास्त्रों पर ज्ञानवर्धक प्रवचन देते हैं और भक्तों को आध्यात्मिक जीवन जीने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: संत राजिंदर सिंहजी

programme.desc: एक आध्यात्मिक पथप्रदर्शक संत राजिंदर सिंहजी महाराज आध्यात्मिकता और रहस्यवाद के बारे में प्रवचन देते हैं जो अपने कार्यों के लिए अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तर पर पहचाने जाते हैं।.

programme.title: पूज्य सतपालजी महाराज
programme.sub-title: Shri Satpal Ji Maharaj's mission is primarily to ignite the spiritual flame in man. The knowledge he teaches, frees one from all restrictions and liberates the mind from all layers of ignorance
programme.desc: एक आध्यात्मिक पथप्रदर्शक भक्ति और आत्म-साक्षात्कार से परिचय कराते हैं, तथा दर्शकों को आंतरिक शांति और जीवन के उद्देश्य की गहरी समझ की ओर मार्गदर्शन करते हैं।.

programme.title: Big Cats Small World
programme.sub-title: Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba are teaching their cubs survival skills whilst keeping them out of the jaws of big male cats
programme.desc: Exploring the lives of big cats, shining a light on the worlds of leopards, lions, and cheetahs.

programme.title: Italy: The Last Wilderness Year 1
programme.sub-title: The biological cycle of Abruzzi's chamois, which are endemic to the highest mountains of Central Italy. The Apennine chamois are an ancient species, but today, they are under serious threat. They are the survivors of a prehistoric species
programme.desc: The story of a remarkable ecosystem in the heart of Europe. Beginning in Vienna, the Danube riverbank forests extend to the gates of Bratislava, forming a unique wildlife habitat.

programme.title: Iberian Vipers
programme.desc: Exploring the behaviour, unique characteristics, and survival strategies of venomous vipers in the Iberian Peninsula.

programme.title: Tigress Blood
programme.desc: Tigers in general are believed to be solitary hunters. But in the forests of Central India, a gang of females learned to hunt co-operatively, taking down large, dangerous prey.

programme.title: Natural Born Monsters
programme.sub-title: Sean Duggan travels to Thailand to investigate the giant snakehead fish in its native habitat. Sean's expedition takes him from Thailand to snakehead-infested Arkansas to see if this killer fish can be stopped
programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures - from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles - in `Natural Born Monsters'. When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.

programme.title: A Game Of Leopard Thrones
programme.desc: Filmed over ten years, an in-depth look at the leopard characters of South Africa and their fascinating unfolding story once their Queen dies.

programme.title: Heroines of The Savannah
programme.desc: Following the lives of three matriarchs from the animal kingdom and showing the valuable role of leading females in wildlife.

programme.title: Animal Attack Rate
programme.sub-title: The filmmakers shed light on some of the deadliest predators in Australia, including reptiles and arachnids with unique biological weapons
programme.desc: Explores some of the most dangerous predators in the wild and calculates how risk it is for a human to protect themselves against them.

programme.title: Snow Leopards with Dan O'Neill
programme.sub-title: Navigating the harsh Mongolian wilderness with Dan O'Neill as he searches for 'The Dude', the largest snow leopard ever recorded
programme.desc: Set against Kyrgyzstan's rugged mountains, Dan O'Neill embarks on a mission to protect one of the world's most elusive creatures: the snow leopard. Following Dan as he works to build a new research centre dedicated to studying these majestic cats.

programme.title: Turtle Walker
programme.desc: In the 1970s, Satish Bhaskar documented sea turtle nesting sites along India's coasts, helping protect the species. The 2004 tsunami later threatened their habitats.

programme.title: Tigress Blood
programme.desc: Tigers in general are believed to be solitary hunters. But in the forests of Central India, a gang of females learned to hunt co-operatively, taking down large, dangerous prey.

programme.title: Fight For Life
programme.desc: Discover the story of the rehabilitation of an African national park. After the first step of successfully acclimatising herbivores, it is time to reintroduce lions. But with them comes predation, and suddenly, fear overtakes the park.

programme.title: Lions versus Hyenas
programme.sub-title: A year has passed since the lionesses of the Boulder Pride bore their cubs. The youngsters have got much bigger and, amazingly, all nine have survived. But the lions in the northern savannah on the border of Kenya and Tanzania have a problem
programme.desc: Although scientists have studied the ecology of African predators for years, few animals are as cliché in the general perception as lions and hyenas: the 'noble kings of the savannah' on the one hand, and the 'cowardly scavengers' on the other.

programme.title: Snow Leopards with Dan O'Neill

programme.desc: Set against Kyrgyzstan's rugged mountains, Dan O'Neill embarks on a mission to protect one of the world's most elusive creatures: the snow leopard. Following Dan as he works to build a new research centre dedicated to studying these majestic cats.

programme.title: Love Wild
programme.desc: Some of the animal kingdom's wildest courtships and mating rituals.

programme.title: Big Cats Small World

programme.desc: Exploring the lives of big cats, shining a light on the worlds of leopards, lions, and cheetahs.

programme.title: Race of Life

programme.desc: The story of a remarkable ecosystem in the heart of Europe. Beginning in Vienna, the Danube riverbank forests extend to the gates of Bratislava, forming a unique wildlife habitat.

programme.title: Natural Born Monsters
programme.sub-title: Sean travels to Costa Rica and comes face-to-face with a monster born from the jungle, the Brazilian Wandering Spider
programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures - from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles - in `Natural Born Monsters'. When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals.

programme.title: Earth's Tropical Islands
programme.desc: From the makers of Earth's Greatest Rivers, Earth's Tropical Islands journeys to three of the most exotic, mysterious and remote islands on planet Earth: Madagascar, Borneo and Hawaii. In three episodes, the series reveals how these isolated and iconic tropical islands harbour remarkable wildlife and human castaways found nowhere else on Earth. Madagascar is the oldest island in the world, Borneo cradles more diversity of life than any other island, and Hawaii is the remotest island chain in the world. In a rapidly changing world, these fragile islands are a vital gauge for the health of our planet.

programme.title: Wild By Nature
programme.desc: WILD BY NATURE is a television series about wild nature, which deals with the endemic fauna of Mexico, narrated from a fresh, intrepid, and original point of view with a message of conservation and care for our species. Our protagonist, the actor and naturalist Arturo Islas travels through the going into their jungles, deserts, and seas in search of the wonderful species of fauna: mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, fish, and insects. WILD BY NATURE is a great experience of adventure and knowledge of natural wealth.

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals.

credits.actor: Jim Breheny,John Sykes,Annie Rivas,Kathleen LaMattina,Pat Thomas,Colleen McCann

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
programme.desc: Carrying on late wildlife conservationist Steve Irwin's mission to bring people closer to animals is now the mission of his family. Terri, Bindi and Robert Irwin return to Animal Planet, giving viewers access to their wildlife adventures around the world and the amazing animals that continue to inspire their conservation efforts. The series features the family caring for more than 1,200 animals at the Australia Zoo; overseeing a world-class wildlife hospital, the largest of its kind in the world; and conducting high-level global expeditions.

programme.title: Into the Wild: India
programme.desc: A journey into India's wilderness highlighting some of its most iconic creatures and diverse habitats. Ranging from tundra to extreme desert, rainforest to urban jungle which provide varied ecological and geographical areas for species to survive.

programme.desc: एक अनुभवी पुलिस अधिकारी जाँच शुरू करता है, जब जुड़वाँ बच्चों की निर्मम हत्याएँ होने लगती हैं। हालाँकि, जल्द ही उसका सामना मनोवैज्ञानिक हेरफेर के एक भयावह खेल से होता है।.

programme.title: रामजी लंदनवाले
programme.sub-title: Ramji, a cook from a small town in India, arrives in London to find out that his employer is dead. He is further saddled with immigration issues that force him to marry Sameera
programme.desc: भारत के एक छोटे शहर से एक रसोइयाँ, रामजी नौकरी के लिए लंडन जाने पर अपने बॉस को मृत पाता है। वह आप्रवास की समस्याओं से जूझता है, जिससे बचने के लिए उसे समीरा से शादी करना होगा।.

programme.title: एनाकोन्डाज: ट्रेल ऑफ ब्लड
programme.sub-title: When an experiment goes wrong, a genetically enhanced anaconda offspring is unleashed. Possessing the power to regenerate, it quickly creates panic and destruction
programme.desc: एक प्रयोग के गलत हो जाने पर आनुवंशिक रूप से बड़े किए गए एनाकोंडा के बच्चे को छोड़ दिया जाता है। पुनर्जनन करने की शक्ति रखने वाला यह एनाकोंडा जल्दी ही आतंक और विनाश का कारण बन जाता है।.

programme.desc: एक युवक अपने दोस्तों की कार दुर्घटना में मृत्यु की भविष्यवाणी करता है और उन्हें घटना से बचने के लिए मनाता है। हालाँकि, उसके आस-पास के लोग रहस्यमय और भयावह परिस्थितियों में मरने लगते हैं।.

programme.title: नमस्ते लंडन

programme.desc: जसमीत के रहन-सहन की बुरी आदतों से उसके पिता दुखी होते हैं। भारत आने पर, जसमीत की शादी अर्जुन से होती है, जो उससे बहुत प्यार करता है, लेकिन जसमीत के लिए यह शादी कोई मायने नहीं रखती है।.

programme.title: आदिपुरुष

programme.desc: अयोध्या के राजकुमार राघव अपनी पत्नी जानकी और भाई शेष के साथ वनवास में रहते हैं। जब लंका का राजा जानकी का अपहरण करका है, तब राघव और उनके सहयोगी उन्हें छुड़ाने निकल पड़ते हैं।.

programme.title: हस्तिनापुर के वीर

programme.desc: पांच वीर पांडव भाई अपने शांतिपूर्ण राज्य को खतरे में डालने वाले खतरे से लड़ने के लिए एकजुट होते हैं। इसके अलावा, धर्म के प्रति उनकी अटूट निष्ठा उन्हें पूर्ण विजय दिलाती है।.

programme.title: क्राइम पैट्रोल
programme.sub-title: The host presents dramatised re-enactments of real-life crime cases that revolve around harassment, kidnapping and murder
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता, उत्पीड़न, अपहरण और हत्या पर आधारित वास्तविक जीवन के आपराधिक मामलों का नाटकीय रूपांतरण प्रस्तुत करते हैं।.

programme.title: बेस्ट ऑफ क्राइम पेट्रोल - क्राइम पेट्रोल सतर्क
programme.sub-title: A compilation of some of the most spine-chilling cases from 'Crime Patrol', which investigates murders, kidnappings and thefts among other heinous crimes
programme.desc: धारावाहिक 'क्राइम पेट्रोल' के रोंगटे खड़े कर देने वाले मामलों का संकलन, जिसमें हत्या, अपहरण, चोरी और अन्य जघन्य अपराधों की जांच की जाती है।.

programme.title: बेस्ट ऑफ़ क्राइम पेट्रोल
programme.sub-title: Some of the best cases of 'Crime Patrol', which investigates how innocent people turn into criminals due to the influence of evil in society
programme.desc: कार्यक्रम, 'क्राइम पेट्रोल' में हत्या, अपहरण, धोखाधड़ी और चोरी जैसे कई अपराधों से जुड़ी सच्ची कहानियों को नाट्य रूपांतरण के माध्यम से पेश किया जाता है।.

programme.title: बेस्ट ऑफ़ क्राइम पेट्रोल
programme.sub-title: Some of the best cases of 'Crime Patrol', which investigates how innocent people turn into criminals due to the influence of evil in society
programme.desc: कार्यक्रम, 'क्राइम पेट्रोल' में हत्या, अपहरण, धोखाधड़ी और चोरी जैसे कई अपराधों से जुड़ी सच्ची कहानियों को नाट्य रूपांतरण के माध्यम से पेश किया जाता है।.

programme.title: क्राइम पेट्रोल: 48 घंटे
programme.sub-title: A man's world comes crashing down around him after his wife falls victim to a heinous crime. Desperate for justice, he takes hostages to put pressure on the police
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता अपराध के मामलों का नाटकीय रूप से मंचन करते हैं तथा पुलिस विभाग द्वारा 48 घंटों के भीतर मामलों को सुलझाने के लिए किए गए सतर्क प्रयासों को दर्शाते हैं।.

programme.title: क्राइम पेट्रोल: 48 घंटे
programme.sub-title: Fearing humiliation in society, a family refuses to file a complaint after their daughter faces molestation at her office. However, Maharashtra police take it upon themselves to identify the culprits
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता अपराध के मामलों का नाटकीय रूप से मंचन करते हैं तथा पुलिस विभाग द्वारा 48 घंटों के भीतर मामलों को सुलझाने के लिए किए गए सतर्क प्रयासों को दर्शाते हैं।.

programme.desc: முத்துவேலுவின் ஒரு பாடல் வீடியோவை காவேரி ஒரு சேனலுக்கு அனுப்பியபின் அவர் பிரபலமடைகிறார், பின்பு அவர் அவளை நேசிக்கிறார்.

credits.actor: Murali (Muthuvelu),Saradha Preetha (Kaveri),Goundamani,Senthil (Chinna Gounder),Vijaya Kumar (Ratnasabapathy),Charan Raj (Sundaram),Shanmuga Sundaram (Ramasamy),Kokila (Deivanai),A. K. Veerasamy (Muthuvelu's grandfather)

programme.title: ரசிக்க ருசிக்க
programme.sub-title: The host interacts with an eminent culinary expert, who shares and demonstrates various recipes from different cuisines

programme.title: கம கம மாலை
programme.sub-title: A seasoned chef displays his culinary skills by conjuring up mouth-watering dishes and demonstrating the cooking method step-by-step
programme.desc: மதிப்புமிக்க குறிப்புகளோடு பல்வேறு உணவுகளை எப்படி சமைக்க வேண்டும் என்பதை படிப்படியாக விளக்கும் ஒரு பிரபல சமையல் நிபுணர்.

programme.title: நியூஸ்

programme.desc: அரசியல், பொருளாதார மற்றும் சமூகப் பிரச்சினைகள் தொடர்பான சமீபத்திய தகவல்கள், முன்னேற்றங்கள் மற்றும் முன்னேற்றங்கள்.

programme.title: உள்ளதை அள்ளிதா

programme.title: Naked and Afraid

programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता भारत के विकास को दिखाने के लिए, यात्राओं के माध्यम से भारत देश के ऐसे तथ्यों के बारे में बताते हैं जो पूर्णता ज्ञात नहीं है।.

programme.title: त्यौहार की थाली
programme.sub-title: The host shares cherished festive recipes, including heirloom dishes, while celebrating the country's culture by exploring its rich folklore
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता देश की समृद्ध लोककथाओं का अन्वेषण करके देश की संस्कृति का जश्न मनाते हुए, पारंपरिक व्यंजनों सहित पसंदीदा त्योहारी रेसिपी साझा करते हैं।.

programme.title: इतिहास की थाली से
programme.sub-title: The host takes an in-depth look at the intriguing history of 'laddoos' and how they came to prominence as desserts in India
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता कुछ रोचक तथ्यों के साथ, विभिन्न व्यंजनों के समृद्ध इतिहास पर प्रकाश डालते हैं जो किसी के सांसारिक जीवन को रोचक बना देते हैं।.

programme.title: इंडिपीडिया
programme.sub-title: Edward decides to fulfill his curiosity by exploring the history and meaning behind the use of unstitched cloth in India
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता भारत के विभिन्न राज्यों की यात्रा करते हैं और उन रीति-रिवाजों और परंपराओं के बारे में अधिक जानकारी प्राप्त करते हैं जो प्राचीन काल से देश का हिस्सा रहे हैं।.

programme.title: एकांत
programme.sub-title: The host explores abandoned historical spots in India that are filled with mystery and studies how these once-flourishing places came to be in ruins
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता भारत में अनेक ऐतिहासिक दृष्टि से महत्वपूर्ण स्थलों की यात्रा करते हैं तथा उनके परित्याग के कारणों की पड़ताल करते हैं।.

programme.title: इटरनल बिहार
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker explores the historic architecture of Bihar, showcasing its grand palaces and educational institutions while examining how these structures reflect the state's evolving cultural legacy
programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता बिहार की भव्य वास्तुकला और ऐतिहासिक स्थलों की खोज करके इसकी समृद्ध विरासत पर प्रकाश डालते हैं।.

programme.title: रक्त
programme.sub-title: As India struggled to gain independence after the First World War, drastic actions were taken by the British Empire to subdue the rebellion
programme.desc: विशेषज्ञ राजाओं द्वारा राज्यों पर अधिकार करने के लिए किए गए कुछ प्रमुख युद्धों और हत्याओं पर विस्तार से चर्चा करते हैं, जिन्होंने आधुनिक भारत की दिशा को आकार दिया।.

programme.title: भारत की आवाज़
programme.sub-title: A compilation of Jawaharlal Nehru's greatest speeches is played back to back as the host unveils his contributions to India
programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता भारत के बेहतरीन वक्ताओं के जुनून और विचारों के बारे में बताते हैं और उनके सबसे प्रतिष्ठित भाषणों पर विशेषज्ञ अपने विचारों के साथ उन्हें साझा करते हैं।.

programme.title: डिस्ट्रक्शन डिकोडेड
programme.sub-title: An in-depth look at catastrophic events, analysing the science behind natural and man-made disasters and exploring the causes and consequences through expert insights and CGI visuals
programme.desc: कार्यक्रम में प्राकृतिक और मानव निर्मित आपदाओं के पीछे के विज्ञान का विश्लेषण और अंतर्दृष्टि और सीजीआई दृश्यों के माध्यम से उनके कारणों और परिणामों पर जानकारी दी जाती है।.

programme.title: रक्त
programme.sub-title: The host explores the unique stories of Panna Devi, a fearless governess, and Ashoka, one of the most iconic emperors of India
programme.desc: विशेषज्ञ राजाओं द्वारा राज्यों पर अधिकार करने के लिए किए गए कुछ प्रमुख युद्धों और हत्याओं पर विस्तार से चर्चा करते हैं, जिन्होंने आधुनिक भारत की दिशा को आकार दिया।.

programme.title: रेजिमेंट डायरीज़
programme.sub-title: The host takes a look at the Jammu And Kashmir Light Infantry Regiment, one of the few army sectors uninfluenced by the British army
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता भारतीय सेना की विभिन्न रेजिमेंटों, उनके प्रशिक्षण, परंपराओं, इतिहास, योगदान और एक नागरिक के सैनिक बनने के तरीके के बारे में जानकारी प्रदान करते हैं।.

programme.title: लक्ष्य 1971: वायू सेना के वीर योद्धा
programme.sub-title: The host explores the various tensions between India and Pakistan in the 1970s, while Indira Gandhi was Prime Minister
programme.desc: फिल्मकार, 1971 के भारत-पाक युद्ध और भारतीय वायु सेना की महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका पर प्रकाश डालते हैं। वे उन प्रमुख घटनाओं पर चर्चा करते हैं, जिनके कारण बांग्लादेश का जन्म हुआ।.

programme.title: व्हाट्स इन द नेम
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker delves into the fascinating stories behind the names of different places while also examining how certain people received various titles
programme.desc: फिल्मकार विभिन्न स्थानों के नामों के पीछे छिपी दिलचस्प कहानियों की पड़ताल करते हैं, साथ ही यह भी बताते हैं कि किस प्रकार उन्होंने विभिन्न उपाधियाँ प्राप्त की।.

programme.title: अदृश्य
programme.sub-title: Azeez-un-Nisa, a courtesan, is enraged by her degraded condition and turns against the British and spies for the Indian rebels. She actively participates with the Indian rebels to plan the uprising
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार, भारत के सबसे महान जासूसों के जीवन की खोज करते हैं, जिन्हें अपने मिशन को अंजाम देते वक्त खतरों का सामना करना पड़ा और राष्ट्रीय सम्मान के लिए अपने जीवन को जोखिम में डाला था।.

credits.actor: Sunny Hinduja (Ravindra Kaushik),Prashantt Guptha (Chand Bardai),Rajesh Khera (Jeevsiddhi),Nishant Singh (Shivaji),Annie Sekhon (Sanyukta),Taranjit Kaur (Durgavati Vohra),Mansi Multani (Azeez-un-Nisa)

programme.title: एपिक टेल्स ऑफ लव
programme.sub-title: A compilation of some of the most popular love stories featuring legendary characters based on various significant Indian historical and cultural legends
programme.desc: विभिन्न महत्वपूर्ण भारतीय ऐतिहासिक और सांस्कृतिक किंवदंतियों पर आधारित पौराणिक पात्रों वाली कुछ सबसे लोकप्रिय प्रेम कहानियों का संकलन।.

programme.title: पोस्टर बॉयज़
programme.sub-title: The lives of three men are ruined when their faces are used in a poster promoting vasectomies. Now ridiculed in society, they decide to protest against the system that humiliated them
programme.desc: चेहरों का इस्तेमाल नसबंदी को बढ़ावा देने वाले एक पोस्टर में करने पर तीन पुरुषों का जीवन बर्बाद हो जाता है। समाज में उपहास का पात्र बनने पर, वे व्यवस्था के खिलाफ विरोध करते हैं।.

credits.actor: Sunny Deol (Jaagavar Chaudhary),Bobby Deol (Vinay Kumar Sharma),Shreyas Talpade (Arjun Singh),Sonali Kulkarni (Sunita Chaudhary),Tripti Dimri (Riya),Lovely Singh (Anjali Chaudhary),Ashwini Kalsekar (Lady Doctor),Ajeet Singh (Murari),Farhana Fatema (Rekha Madam),Randheer Rai (Anuj Chaudhary),Samikssha Batnagar (Suraj Mukhi Sharma),Purnima Varma (Aashtha)

programme.title: भाई बहन
programme.sub-title: The son of a wealthy man finds the company of bad friends. However, he returns home to his father who welcomes him with open arms
programme.desc: एक अमीर आदमी का बेटा बुरे दोस्तों की संगत पाता है। हालांकि, जब वह घर लौटता है तब उसके पिता उसका खुली बाहों से स्वागत करते है।.

programme.title: आँखों में तुम हो
programme.sub-title: An astrologer's advice separates two lovers, bringing unfortunate circumstances in their lives and the lives of those around them
programme.desc: एक ज्योतिषी की सलाह दो प्रेमियों को अलग कर देती है, जिससे उनके जीवन और उनके आसपास के लोगों के जीवन में दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण स्थितियाँ पैदा हो जाती हैं।.

credits.actor: Sharad Kapoor (Pratap Burman/Ranjeet),Suman Ranganathan (Pooja),Rohit Roy (Prem),Raakhee Gulzar (Ranimaa)

programme.title: जुनून
programme.sub-title: Vikram is badly injured, and his friend is killed by a cursed tiger. He soon learns that the curse has been passed onto him, and he will turn into a tiger on a full moon night
programme.desc: एक शापग्रस्त शेर के कारण विक्रम बुरी तरह घायल होता है और उसके दोस्त को मारा जाता है। जल्द ही, विक्रम को पता चलता है कि अब शाप उसपर आ गया है और वह पूर्णिमा की रात को एक शेर में परिवर्तित हो जाएगा।.

credits.actor: Rahul Roy,Pooja Bhatt,Tom Alter,Rakesh Bedi,Avtar Gill,Avinash Wadhavan,K.D. Chandran,Shubha Khote

programme.title: शेषनाग
programme.sub-title: Pritam and Banu, two shape-shifting snakes in human form, seek protection from a young man when an evil priest tries to hunt them down and use them in a ritual for wealth and immortality
programme.desc: दो इच्छाधारी सांप, प्रीतम और बानू, एक सांप भक्त से सुरक्षा की तलाश करते हैं जब एक दुष्ट पुजारी उनकी शिकार करने की कोशिश करता है और धन और अमरत्व के लिए अनुष्ठान में उनका उपयोग करना चाहता है।.

programme.title: मेरा दामाद
programme.sub-title: Jai's father asks him to meet Sunita before getting married to her. However, complications arise when Jai falls in love with Kimi, while on his way to Sunita's village
programme.desc: जय के पिता उससे शादी करने से पहले सुनीता से मिलने के लिए कहते हैं। हालाँकि, मुश्किलें तब पैदा होती हैं जब सुनीता के गाँव जाते समय जय को किरी से प्यार हो जाता है।.

credits.actor: Farooq Shaikh (Jai Khanna),Zarina Wahab (Kimi/Sunita),Ashok Kumar (Barrister Ajit Khanna),Utpal Dutt (Sitanath Chaudhary),Rakesh Bedi (Ravi),Prema Narayan (Shalu),Brahmachari,Master Bhagwan,Jankidas (Shalu's Bapu)

programme.title: प्यार के नाम क़ुर्बान
programme.sub-title: Billu attempts to play Holi with Devika, but she gets him arrested. In an attempt to take revenge, he kidnaps her, which infuriates her brother, who sets out to save her
programme.desc: बिल्लू देविका के साथ होली खेलने की कोशिश करता है, लेकिन देविका उसे गिरफ्तार करवा देती है। बदला लेने के लिए, वह देविका का अपहरण कर लेता है, जिससे देविका का भाई क्रोधित हो जाता है।.

credits.actor: Mithun Chakraborty,Dimple Kapadia,Mandakini,Danny Denzongpa,Raza Murad,Yunus Pravez,Paintal,Gulshan Grover

programme.title: तकदीरवाला
programme.sub-title: Yamraj and Chitragupta descend to Earth to look for the missing book of destiny. Soon, they find it in the possession of a man who refuses to part with it because it contains information of his mother's lifespan
programme.desc: यमराज और चित्रगुप्त, भविष्यवाणी की किताब खो जाने के बाद, उसे ढूँढने के लिए भूलोक पर आते हैं। उन्हें किताब एक ऐसे युवक के पास मिलती है, जो उसे लौटाने के लिए तैयार नहीं है।.

credits.actor: Venkatesh (Suraj),Raveena Tandon (Lilly),Kader Khan (Yamraj),Asrani (Chitragupta),Shakti Kapoor (Chhota Ravan),Anupam Kher (Inspector Ranjit Singh),Laxmikant Berde (Pandu),Reema Lagoo (Suraj's mother),Dinesh Hingoo (Editor),Satyendra Kappu (Gopal Kaka),Rakesh Pandey (Brahma),Tiku Talsania (Marwadi Seth)

programme.title: आँखें
programme.sub-title: After being sacked from his position as a bank manager, a temperamental man plots revenge by orchestrating a robbery, enlisting three unlikely accomplices
programme.desc: बैंक मैनेजर के पद से बर्खास्त होने के बाद, एक गुस्सैल व्यक्ति तीन अप्रत्याशित साथियों को शामिल करते हुए डकैती की योजना बनाता है।.

programme.title: तड़ीपार
programme.sub-title: Shankar comes across Namkeen and discovers that she resembles Mohinidevi, a millionaire who has gone missing. Sensing an opportunity to acquire riches, he asks Namkeen to impersonate Mohinidevi
programme.desc: शंकर की मुलाकात नमकीन से होती है जो करोडों की मालकिन मोहिनीदेवी की हमशक्ल है, और लापता हो चुकी है। धनवान बनने का मौका देखकर, वह नमकीन से मोहिनीदेवी का रूप धारण करने को कहता है।.

programme.title: उर्दू न्यूज़
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television

programme.title: आज का मुद्दा

programme.title: रंगोली
programme.sub-title: The host presents a compilation of popular Bollywood songs composed and performed by talented artists in a non-stop sequence
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रतिभावान कलाकारों द्वारा रचित और प्रस्तुत लोकप्रिय बॉलीवुड गीतों का एक निरंतर क्रम में संकलन प्रस्तुत करते हैं।.

programme.title: खजुराहो
programme.sub-title: The Khajuraho Group of Monuments is a cluster of Hindu and Jain temples in Madhya Pradesh's Chhatarpur district. These ancient landmarks are a UNESCO World Heritage Site
programme.desc: खजुराहो स्मारक समूह मध्य प्रदेश के छतरपुर जिले में हिंदू और जैन मंदिरों का एक समूह है। ये प्राचीन स्थल यूनेस्को की विश्व धरोहर स्थल हैं।.

programme.title: नर्गिस
programme.sub-title: Nargis's world turns upside down when she learns the truth about her biological mother. She resolves to find her whilst navigating the challenges of her life
programme.desc: नर्गिस को अपनी असली माँ के बारे में सच्चाई पता चलती है, तो उसकी दुनिया बदल जाती है। वह अपनी माँ को खोजने का निश्चय करती है और अपनी ज़िंदगी की चुनौतियों से निपटती है।.

programme.title: वाह क्या टेस्ट है
programme.sub-title: The host interacts with chefs from some of the most famous restaurants and hotels in India and showcases their recipes for various mouth-watering dishes
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता भारत के कुछ सबसे प्रसिद्ध रेस्टोरेंट और होटलों के शेफ़्स से बातचीत करते हैं और विभिन्न स्वादिष्ट व्यंजनों की उनकी रेसिपीज़ प्रदर्शित करते हैं।.

programme.title: एयर होस्टेस्स
programme.sub-title: The glamorous cabin crew of an airline faces a lot of struggles and differences caused due to the politics within the industry

programme.title: सावित्री एक क्रांति
programme.sub-title: Savitri, a trailblazing young girl, defies societal conventions and rises to become a pioneering social reformer and India's first female educator
programme.desc: युवती सावित्री, सामाजिक बाधाओं को तोड़ती है और बड़ी होकर एक समाज सुधारक के साथ-साथ भारत की पहली महिला शिक्षिका बनती है।.

programme.desc: गुंजन, एक जिंदादिल शहरी किशोरी, अपनी माँ की मृत्यु के बाद अपनी चाची के साथ रहने के लिए एक शांत शहर में चली जाती है। बाद में, उसे अपनी शर्मीली चचेरी बहन रचना में सांत्वना मिलती है।.

programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता दिन भर के सामाजिक, आर्थिक और राजनीतिक मुद्दों से जुड़े नवीनतम समाचार, ताज़ा जानकारी और घटनाक्रम पेश करते हैं।.

programme.title: सेहत और स्वाद के रंग
programme.sub-title: A chef showcases methods for making nutritious, flavourful meals, while offering inventive kitchen hacks to enhance cooking and elevate dishes
programme.desc: एक शेफ पौष्टिक, स्वादिष्ट भोजन बनाने के तरीकों को प्रदर्शित करते हैं, साथ ही खाना पकाने को बेहतर बनाने और व्यंजनों को बेहतर बनाने के लिए रचनात्मक रसोई हैक्स भी पेश करते हैं।.

programme.title: न्यूज़ 360
programme.sub-title: The host presents the latest news and developments surrounding various socio-economic and political issues and provides updates on current events
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता विभिन्न सामाजिक-आर्थिक और राजनीतिक मुद्दों से संबंधित नवीनतम समाचार और घटनाक्रम पेश करते हैं तथा समसामयिक घटनाओं पर ताजा जानकारी प्रदान करते हैं।.

programme.title: ओपन माइक विथ म्यूज़िक
programme.sub-title: The host presents a platform for musical talents, showcasing their performances and giving artists the opportunity to display their skills and creativity
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता संगीत प्रतिभाओं के लिए एक मंच प्रस्तुत करते हैं, जहां वे अपना प्रदर्शन पेश करते हैं और कलाकारों को अपने कौशल एवं रचनात्मकता को प्रदर्शित करने का अवसर प्रदान करते हैं।.

programme.title: यूपी के शहरों से
programme.sub-title: The host talks about the developments schemes by government and culture of different cities in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता भारतीय राज्य उत्तर प्रदेश के विभिन्न शहरों की सरकार की विकास योजनाओं और संस्कृति के बारे में बात करते हैं।.

programme.title: गोदान
programme.sub-title: Hori Mahato, a peasant, is desperate for a cow, a symbol of prestige in the 1930's rural India. However, his dream is shattered when he buys one after taking out a loan and his jealous brother poisons it
programme.desc: 1930 के दशक के ग्रामीण भारत में किसान होरी महतो को गाय से बहुत लगाव होता है। हालाँकि, उसके कर्ज लेकर खरीदी गई गाय को उसके ईर्ष्यालु भाई के जहर देने पर वह टूट जाता है।.

programme.title: गोल्डन हिट्स
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of famous old melodies from popular Kollywood movies performed by eminent artists is played in quick succession
programme.desc: विभिन्न प्रतिष्ठित और मधुर संगीतकारों द्वारा लगातार सदाबहार धुनों का व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.desc: ఒక కళాశాల యువకుడు తన శక్తులను కనుగొని ప్రపంచాన్ని ఒక దుష్ట విలన్ నుండి రక్షించే సూపర్ హీరో గా రూపాంతరం చెందుతాడు.

programme.title: పాండా మరియు రూస్టర్ సాహసాలు
programme.sub-title: A Panda and a rooster become friends as they set out on exciting adventures to explore the vibrant cultures of various countries while promoting the concept of cultural diversity
programme.desc: పాండా, కోడిపుంజు స్నేహితులై సాంస్కృతిక వైవిధ్యాన్ని ప్రోత్సహిస్తూ, వివిధ దేశాల ఉత్సాహభరితమైన సంస్కృతులను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: డేంజర్ మౌస్
programme.sub-title: Danger Mouse, a talented secret agent, and his faithful sidekick, Ernest Penfold, do all they can to thwart the evil plans of Baron Silas von Greenback
programme.desc: రహస్య ఏజెంట్ డేంజర్ మౌస్, ఎర్నెస్ట్ పెన్ఫోల్డ్ తో కలిసి గ్రీన్ బ్యాక్ దుష్ట ప్రణాళికలను అడ్డుకోడానికి ప్రత్నిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Alexander Armstrong (Danger Mouse),Dave Lamb,Kevin Eldon (Penfold),Stephen Fry (Colonel K)

programme.title: ఖుషీ రాముడు
programme.sub-title: Rama, together with his siblings and companions, embarks on numerous adventures while undergoing training at Vashist Ashram Gurukul
programme.desc: రాముడు, తన సోదరులు మరియు సహచరులతో కలిసి, వశిష్ఠ ఆశ్రమ గురుకులంలో శిక్షణ పొందుతూ అనేక సాహసయాత్రలను చేపడతాడు.

programme.title: వేక్ అప్ మ్యూజిక్ ఐడీ
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive collection of refreshing songs to help audiences kick-start the day, featuring popular artists and bands
programme.desc: ప్రముఖ కళాకారులు, బ్యాండ్‌ల పాటలతో, శ్రోతలు తమ రోజును ఉత్సాహంగా ప్రారంభించడానికి సహాయపడే ఉత్తేజకరమైన పాటల సమగ్ర సమాహారం.

programme.title: పంచతంత్ర నీతి కథలు
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of stories from the Panchatantra, a collection of Indian fables, that helps to instil morals and values in children
programme.desc: భారతీయ నీతి కథల సమాహారమైన, పంచతంత్ర కథల సమగ్ర సంకలనం, ఇది పిల్లలలో నైతికత, విలువలను పెంపొందించడానికి సహాయపడుతుంది.

programme.title: హ్యాపీ బర్త్ డే
programme.sub-title: Children celebrate their birthdays with a heart-touching note from their loved ones on the occasion of the special memorable day
programme.desc: పిల్లలు తమకు ఎంతో ప్రత్యేకమైన రోజు నాడు, తమ ప్రియమైన వారి నుండి హృదయాన్ని హత్తుకునే సందేశాలతో పుట్టినరోజు జరుపుకుంటారు.

programme.desc: सिम्बा, एक ईमानदार और साहसी पुलिस अधिकारी, अपने निडर सहयोगियों के साथ मिलकर समाज की बुरी ताकतों का सामना करने और उन्हें हराने के मिशन पर निकलता है।.

programme.title: छोटा भीम
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur
programme.desc: भीम एक असाधारण, शक्तिशाली और बुद्धिमान लड़का है। गाँव के सभी बच्चे उसे पसंद करते हैं, क्योंकि वह सभी की समस्याओं को हल करने में उनकी मदद करता है।.

credits.actor: Vatsal Dubey (Chhota Bheem),Julie Tejwani (Raju),Rupa Bhimani (Chutki),Sabina Malik Mausam (Kalia),Rajesh Kava (Jaggu),Prince Patel (Takiya)

programme.title: लिटिल कृष्ण
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna, a mischievous child, lives in the village of Vrindavan. He decides to save the villagers from an evil king, Kamsa, who sends ferocious demons upon them
programme.desc: एक शरारती बच्चा छोटा कृष्ण वृंदावन गाँव में रहता है। वह क्रूर राक्षसों को ग्रामीणों पर हमला के लिए भेजने वाले एक दुष्ट राजा, कंस से उन्हें बचाने का फैसला करता है।.

credits.actor: Prachi Save Saathi,Meghna Erande,Neil D'Monte,Anand Tiwari,Vikrant Chaturvedi,Soniya Nair,Cara Pareira

programme.title: लिटिल कृष्णा मेलडिज
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna has fun getting caught up in all sorts of mischief with his friends in Vrindavan. But when the evil Kansa sends his minions to disrupt his life, he jumps into action
programme.desc: नन्हे कृष्ण वृंदावन में अपने दोस्तों के साथ तरह-तरह की शरारतें करते हुए मज़े करते हैं। लेकिन जब दुष्ट कंस उनके जीवन में खलल डालने के लिए अपने अनुचर भेजता है, तब वे तुरंत हरकत में आ जाते हैं।.

programme.title: ग्रिजी एण्ड द लेम्मिंग्स
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: ग्रिज़ी नामक भालू, हर बार जब वन रेंजर घर छोड़ता है तो उसके घर में रहता है और उसे अपना घर मानता है। हालाँकि, जब लेमिंग्स की एक जनजाति उसी घर में रहने आती है तो चीजें बदल जाती हैं।.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.sub-title: Grizzy and the Lemmings embark on an exciting adventure across the world, while causing chaos in each other's lives on their tour
programme.desc: ग्रिज़ी और लेमिंग्स, दुनिया भर में एक रोमांचक साहसिक यात्रा पर निकलते हैं, साथ ही यात्रा के दौरान एक-दूसरे के जीवन में उत्पात मचाते हैं।.

programme.title: सम्पत चम्पत
programme.sub-title: Follow the hilarious misadventures of Sampat and Champat, two bumbling thieves who constantly hatch chaotic plans that backfire, landing them in endless trouble with the local police
programme.desc: सम्पत और चम्पत, दो चोर, लगातार ऐसी गड़बड़ योजनाएँ बनाते रहते हैं जो उन्हीं पर भारी पड़ जाती हैं, और जिसके चलते वे स्थानीय पुलिस के साथ कभी न खत्म होने वाली मुसीबतों में फँस जाते हैं।.

programme.title: माइटी लिट्ल भीम
programme.sub-title: Bheem, an affectionate toddler, has many adventures with his little friends and loving family. Every day he learns something new as he grows taller
programme.desc: एक स्नेही बच्चा भीम अपने छोटे दोस्तों और प्यारे परिवार के साथ कई रोमांच करता है। जैसे-जैसे वह बड़ा होता है वह हर दिन कुछ नया सीखता है।.

programme.title: छोटा भीम
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur
programme.desc: भीम एक असाधारण, शक्तिशाली और बुद्धिमान लड़का है। गाँव के सभी बच्चे उसे पसंद करते हैं, क्योंकि वह सभी की समस्याओं को हल करने में उनकी मदद करता है।.

programme.title: जय जगन्नाथ
programme.sub-title: The host shines light on the annual chariot procession held in the honour of Lord Jagannath in Puri, Odisha, which is attended by numerous devotees from all over the country
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता ओडिशा के पुरी में भगवान जगन्नाथ की स्तुति में आयोजित वार्षिक रथ यात्रा पर प्रकाश डालते हैं, जिसमें देश भर से बड़ी संख्या में भक्त शामिल होते हैं।.

programme.title: लिटिल सिंघम
programme.sub-title: Little Singham, an honest but ferocious police officer, fights against injustice and defends his town from formidable enemies
programme.desc: एक ईमानदार लेकिन उद्दंड पुलिस अधिकारी, लिटिल सिंघम अन्याय के कई मामलों के विरुद्ध लड़ता है जो समाज में हो रहे हैं।.

programme.title: ग्रिजी एण्ड द लेम्मिंग्स
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: ग्रिज़ी नामक भालू, हर बार जब वन रेंजर घर छोड़ता है तो उसके घर में रहता है और उसे अपना घर मानता है। हालाँकि, जब लेमिंग्स की एक जनजाति उसी घर में रहने आती है तो चीजें बदल जाती हैं।.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.title: ग्रिजी एण्ड द लेम्मिंग्स
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: ग्रिज़ी नामक भालू, हर बार जब वन रेंजर घर छोड़ता है तो उसके घर में रहता है और उसे अपना घर मानता है। हालाँकि, जब लेमिंग्स की एक जनजाति उसी घर में रहने आती है तो चीजें बदल जाती हैं।.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.title: वाइल्ड फ्रैंक इन इंडिया

programme.title: मैन वर्सेस बियर
programme.sub-title: Contestants compete against three grizzly bears, Bart, Honey Bump and Tank, in a series of tasks that tests their strength and endurance
programme.desc: प्रतियोगी कार्यों की एक श्रृंखला में तीन भूरे भालू, बार्ट, हनी बम्प और टैंक के खिलाफ प्रतिस्पर्धा करते हैं जो उनकी ताकत और सहनशक्ति का परीक्षण करते हैं।.

programme.title: लाइअनिस इन एग्ज़ाइल

programme.title: लायन्स एण्ड हाइनास

programme.title: वाइल्ड डाइनेस्टीस

programme.title: सेरेनगेटी: जर्नी टू द हार्ट ऑफ अफ्रीका

programme.title: अफ्रीकाज़ सीक्रेट क्रिएचर्स
programme.sub-title: Diverse animal species display unique resilience and behaviour, facing numerous challenges as they adapt and struggle to survive in the wild

programme.title: हिप्पोस आफ्टर डार्क
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker captures the extreme power play and struggle for survival between a pride of lions and a herd of hippos under the protection of a ferocious bull as night falls

In addition to drastically changing their appearances, they hope to reclaim their independence, mend relationships with friends and family, and renew their feelings of self-worth.

programme.title: Bering Sea Gold
programme.sub-title: Shawn has a bold plan to rebuild the Myrtle Irene. Zeke tests out his unique sailboat dredge, and Vernon exams his claim with an underwater drone
programme.desc: The gold rush in Alaska isn't confined to the state's precious ground. It's taking place on the sea ... or more accurately, on the bottom of the frigid Bering Sea. This series, from the creators of the Emmy-winning \"Deadliest Catch,\" follows four gold dredges and their eccentric and driven crews who risk their lives to find as much gold as possible before winter sets in and it's too dangerous to dive. The custom-built rigs, some barely seaworthy, include an 80-foot barge run by the most successful gold dredger in Nome, Alaska, and a modified skiff that seats only two people.

programme.title: Houdini's Last Secrets
programme.sub-title: The life of Harry Houdini remains as much of a mystery as his death. A team of magicians and scientists try to unlock the secrets he took with him to the grave
programme.desc: Cracking a magician's code used to be strictly against industry standards. Now, it seems the magic has disappeared from that concept, and even legendary performers such as Harry Houdini are not immune. This series looks to uncover the methods to Houdini's breathtaking escapes and astonishing illusions, which have never been equalled or fully understood. How did this showman catch a speeding bullet, submerge himself in a water torture cell, or survive being buried alive? Helping piece together clues and testing out his most daring stunts are Houdini's grand-nephew George Hardeen, magician and daredevil Lee Terbosic, and master stunt builder Steve Wolf.

Hour-long episodes count down the best clips, supported by a team of actual scientists who analyse the principles behind the backyard shenanigans.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.sub-title: Two superfans take on Mexico's Yucatán jungle for 14 days. However, they have to rely on sheer grit to battle brutal storms, vampire bats and unrelenting hunger
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.sub-title: Two superfans take on Mexico's Yucatán jungle for 14 days. However, they have to rely on sheer grit to battle brutal storms, vampire bats and unrelenting hunger
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: नेकेड एण्ड अफ्रेड
programme.sub-title: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well
programme.desc: अजनबियों के कई जोड़ों को सुनसान और ख़तरनाक जंगलों में खूँखार वन्यजीवों से बचते हुए निर्वस्त्र रहकर सिर्फ दो चीज़ों की मदद से जीवित रहने की चुनौती को पूरा करना होगा।.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

programme.title: नेकेड एण्ड अफ्रेड
programme.sub-title: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well
programme.desc: अजनबियों के कई जोड़ों को सुनसान और ख़तरनाक जंगलों में खूँखार वन्यजीवों से बचते हुए निर्वस्त्र रहकर सिर्फ दो चीज़ों की मदद से जीवित रहने की चुनौती को पूरा करना होगा।.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

programme.title: నేకెడ్ అండ్ అఫ్రైడ్
programme.sub-title: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well
programme.desc: తీవ్ర వాతావరణంలో భయపడకుండా అరణ్యంలోని ప్రమాదకరమైన వన్యప్రాణుల నుండి బయటపడటానికి అపరిచితులు జత కడతారు.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

programme.title: నేకెడ్ అండ్ అఫ్రైడ్
programme.sub-title: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well
programme.desc: తీవ్ర వాతావరణంలో భయపడకుండా అరణ్యంలోని ప్రమాదకరమైన వన్యప్రాణుల నుండి బయటపడటానికి అపరిచితులు జత కడతారు.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

programme.desc: వివిధ రంగాలలోని ఇద్దరు నిపుణులు పిల్లల బృందానికి సంక్లిష్టమైన భావనలను వివరించడానికి ఒకరితో ఒకరు పోటీపడతారు.

programme.title: ద ఫాస్ట్ హిస్టరీ ఆఫ్
programme.sub-title: Explore how an eccentric man who sold chicken at a gas station founded the largest chicken empire in the world and also managed to transform himself into a global icon
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు పురాణ కంపెనీల గతాన్ని పరిశీలించి, యూఎఫ్ఓలు, బిలియనీర్ల చరిత్రను తెలుసుకోడానికి ప్రయాణాన్ని ప్రారంభిస్తారు.

programme.title: ది అన్‌బిలీవబుల్ విత్ డాన్ అక్రాయిడ్

programme.title: టూర్ డి రాయల్

programme.title: संकीर्तन
programme.sub-title: Hindu devotees and religious leaders gather to offer their sincere prayers to the Almighty and seek divine blessings through devotional songs

programme.title: पूज्य गुरु मी मां जी
programme.sub-title: Pujya Guru Mee Maa ji

programme.title: सत्संग-अमृत
programme.sub-title: A spiritual leader explores the path to a pious life through the wisdom of Hinduism, sharing timeless precepts as well as teachings
programme.desc: एक आध्यात्मिक पथ-प्रदर्शक हिंदू धर्म के ज्ञान के माध्यम से पवित्र जीवन के मार्ग की खोज कर, कालातीत उपदेशों के साथ-साथ शिक्षाओं को भी साझा करते हैं।.

programme.title: आचार्य बालकृषण जी
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the benefits of 'Ayurveda' and shares various treatments to help patients suffering from various ailments
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, 'आयुर्वेद' के लाभों पर प्रकाश डालते हैं तथा विभिन्न बीमारियों से पीड़ित रोगियों की मदद के लिए विभिन्न उपचार बताते हैं।.

programme.title: मोरारी बापू

programme.title: योगऋषि स्वामी रामदेवजी महाराज

programme.title: जतिन अग्रवाल जी

programme.desc: स्वामी हरि चैतन्य जी भक्तों के एक समूह को विभिन्न धार्मिक पहलुओं पर प्रवचन देते हैं, तथा उन्हें आध्यात्मिकता के सिद्धांतों का पालन करने के लिए प्रेरित करते हैं।.

programme.sub-title: Hindu priests and devotees perform rituals and chant sacred verses in praise of Lord Krishna at the ISKCON Temple in India
programme.desc: भारत में इस्कॉन मंदिर में हिंदू पुजारी और भक्त भगवान कृष्ण की स्तुति में अनुष्ठान करते हैं और पवित्र श्लोकों का जाप करते हैं।.

programme.title: मिनरल गुरु
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television

programme.title: संत रामपाल जी महाराज
programme.sub-title: Sant Rampal Ji Maharaj delivers a discourse based on sacred religious scriptures and imparts their significance among the followers
programme.desc: संत रामपाल जी महाराज पवित्र धार्मिक ग्रंथों पर आधारित प्रवचन देते हैं और अनुयायियों के बीच उनका महत्व बताते हैं।.

programme.title: ப்ரேயர் டைம்
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and shares valuable lessons from various scriptures, encouraging followers to walk the path of spirituality
programme.desc: ஒரு மதத் தலைவர் சர்வவல்லவரின் போதனைகளை வெளிச்சம் போட்டுக் காட்டி, பக்தர்களை ஆன்மீகப் பாதையில் நடக்க ஊக்குவிக்கிறார்.

programme.sub-title: A religious scholar delivers a spiritual discourse on the importance of leading a righteous life and discusses the significance of devotion

programme.title: டாக்டர் ஆனந்த் ஸ்திரா
programme.sub-title: A religious leader shares the message of God, emphasising His importance in guiding humanity and urging followers to embrace spirituality
programme.desc: கடவுளின் செய்தியை பகிர்ந்து, மனிதகுலத்தை அவர் வழிநடத்துவது பற்றி விளக்கி, ஆன்மீகத்தை தழுவுமாறு வலியுறுத்தும் மத தலைவர்.

programme.title: பாஸ்டர் ஃப்ராங்க்ளின்
programme.sub-title: A religious leader delivers a discourse on the teachings of the Holy Bible and encourages followers to embrace the path of spirituality
programme.desc: ஒரு மதத் தலைவர்பைபிளின் போதனைகள் குறித்து ஒரு சொற்பொழிவை நிகழ்த்தி, ஆன்மீக பாதையைத் தழுவுமாறு பக்தர்களை ஊக்குவிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: இன் டச் மினிஸ்ட்ரீஸ்
programme.sub-title: A religious leader delivers a discourse and recites verses from the Holy Bible, encouraging devotees to lead a righteous life
programme.desc: ஒரு மதத் தலைவர் பிரசங்கத்தை வழங்கி, பைபிளிலிருந்து வசனங்களை படித்து, பக்தர்களை நேர்மையான வாழ்க்கையை வாழ ஊக்குவிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: டாக்டர் ஜான் அங்கர்பர்க்

programme.desc: கிறிஸ்தவத்தின் செய்தியை பகிர்ந்து, தெய்வீக போதனைகளை பின்பற்ற பக்தர்களை ஊக்குவிக்கும் நிபுணரான டாக்டர் ஜான் ஆங்கர்பர்க்.

programme.title: புதிய பூமி
programme.sub-title: Katheeravan is a doctor who saves the life of Kangeyan, a criminal. When Kangeyan realises that Katheeravan is the son of the policeman hunting him, he tries to kill him
programme.desc: டாக்டர். கதிரவனை ஒரு விபத்திலிருந்து ஒரு பெண் காப்பாற்றுகிறாள். பின்பு, கதிரவன் கிராமத்திற்கு சேவை செய்ய எண்ணுகிறார்.

programme.title: தெருக்கூத்து

programme.title: மருத்துவ நேரம்

programme.title: கூட்டாஞ்சோறு
programme.sub-title: The host visits various restaurants throughout the country and interacts with the chefs, who prepare exotic cuisine, and shares their recipes

programme.title: Power to the People
programme.desc: `Power to the People' is an observational documentary exploring Britain's energy industry. The series films the daily activities of employees at SSE, one of Britain's `Big Six' energy companies. Over the course of a year, the cameras capture the reality behind electricity production versus consumption. As more and more old power stations are closed down, the company battles to find new sources to keep the country's power switched on. One such investment includes the world's second largest offshore wind farm, Greater Gabbard, where technicians discuss the potential of this 1.7-billion pound project.

programme.title: Power to the People
programme.desc: `Power to the People' is an observational documentary exploring Britain's energy industry. The series films the daily activities of employees at SSE, one of Britain's `Big Six' energy companies. Over the course of a year, the cameras capture the reality behind electricity production versus consumption. As more and more old power stations are closed down, the company battles to find new sources to keep the country's power switched on. One such investment includes the world's second largest offshore wind farm, Greater Gabbard, where technicians discuss the potential of this 1.7-billion pound project.

programme.desc: చాగంటి కోటేశ్వరరావు గారు భగవంతుడి బోధనలను వివరిస్తూ, భక్తులను ఆధ్యాత్మిక మార్గంలో నడవమని ప్రోత్సహిస్తారు.

programme.title: సామవేదం ప్రవచనం
programme.sub-title: A religious leader delivers discourses on the Sama Veda, one of the ancient Hindu scriptures, to a gathering of devotees in order to inspire them to follow the path of righteousness
programme.desc: ఒక ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువు, ప్రాచీన గ్రంథాలలో ఒకటైన సామవేదంపై ఉపన్యాసమిచ్చి, ధర్మ మార్గాన్ని అనుసరించమని ప్రోత్సహిస్తారు.

programme.title: స్తోత్ర మాలికా
programme.sub-title: A compilation of devotional songs and verses is played back-to-back in order to encourage the audience to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: ప్రేక్షకులను ఆధ్యాత్మిక మార్గంలో నడవడానికి ప్రోత్సహించే ఉద్దేశ్యంతో, భక్తి గీతాలు, శ్లోకాల సంకలనాన్ని ప్రసారం చేస్తారు.

programme.title: అర్చన

programme.desc: இந்தியா முழுவதும் உள்ள பல்வேறு இந்து கோவில்கள் மற்றும் புனித யாத்திரை தலங்களின் மத மற்றும் ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவம்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு சஹஸ்ரநாமம்
programme.sub-title: Hindu religious leaders and devotees chant a Sanskrit hymn listing the 1,000 names of Lord Vishnu to seek his divine blessings
programme.desc: இந்து மதத் தலைவர்களும் பக்தர்களும் விஷ்ணுவின் 1,000 நாமங்களைக் கொண்ட சமஸ்கிருத பாடலைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: மதுரை காளியம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees gather at a pious shrine to offer their sincere prayers, worship the Almighty and seek divine blessings
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் சன்னதியில் கூடி தங்கள் பிரார்த்தனைகளை வழங்கி, இறைவனை வணங்கி, தெய்வீக ஆசீகளைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு ஷேத்திரம்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees assemble to perform a ceremonial ritual, offering worship and seeking the divine blessings of Lord Vishnu
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் கூடி, ஒரு சடங்கு சடங்கை செய்து, வழிபாடு செய்து, விஷ்ணுவின் தெய்வீக ஆசீர்வாதத்தைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: பக்தி பாடல்கள்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of popular devotional songs in praise of deities performed by eminent artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: புகழ்பெற்ற கலைஞர்களால் நடத்தப்படும் தெய்வங்களைப் போற்றும் பிரபலமான பக்திப் பாடல்கள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: சத்குரு
programme.sub-title: Sadhguru, a spiritual guru, gives a discourse on the teachings from the scriptures and urges his followers to walk on the path of righteousness
programme.desc: வேதங்களிலிருந்து போதனைகள் பற்றிய சொற்பொழிவை வழங்கி, பக்தர்களை நீதியின் பாதையில் செல்ல தூண்டும் ஆன்மீக குருவான சத்குரு.

programme.title: ஸ்ரீமத் பாகவதம்

programme.sub-title: Hindu religious leaders and devotees chant a Sanskrit hymn listing the 1,000 names of Lord Vishnu to seek his divine blessings
programme.desc: இந்து மதத் தலைவர்களும் பக்தர்களும் விஷ்ணுவின் 1,000 நாமங்களைக் கொண்ட சமஸ்கிருத பாடலைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: மதுரை காளியம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees gather at a pious shrine to offer their sincere prayers, worship the Almighty and seek divine blessings
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் சன்னதியில் கூடி தங்கள் பிரார்த்தனைகளை வழங்கி, இறைவனை வணங்கி, தெய்வீக ஆசீகளைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு ஷேத்திரம்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees assemble to perform a ceremonial ritual, offering worship and seeking the divine blessings of Lord Vishnu
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் கூடி, ஒரு சடங்கு சடங்கை செய்து, வழிபாடு செய்து, விஷ்ணுவின் தெய்வீக ஆசீர்வாதத்தைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: பக்தி பாடல்கள்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of popular devotional songs in praise of deities performed by eminent artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: புகழ்பெற்ற கலைஞர்களால் நடத்தப்படும் தெய்வங்களைப் போற்றும் பிரபலமான பக்திப் பாடல்கள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: சத்குரு

programme.desc: வேதங்களிலிருந்து போதனைகள் பற்றிய சொற்பொழிவை வழங்கி, பக்தர்களை நீதியின் பாதையில் செல்ல தூண்டும் ஆன்மீக குருவான சத்குரு.

programme.title: ஸ்ரீமத் பாகவதம்

programme.desc: ஆன்மீகத் தலைவர் ஆழ்ந்த ஞானத்தைப் பகிர்ந்து இந்து கடவுளான கிருஷ்ணரின் வாழ்க்கையை விவரிக்கும் தகவல் உரையை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.desc: மத தலைவர் பக்தர்களுக்கு அறிவூட்டவும், ஆன்மீக பாதையில் வழிநடத்தவும் தேவனின் போதனைகள் குறித்த சொற்பொழிவை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: சுப்ரபாதம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional songs and hymns in praise of the divine written by various artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட தெய்வீகத்தைப் போற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்கள் மேலும் கீர்த்தனைகள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: கந்தசஷ்டிக்கவசம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of religious hymns and devotional songs in praise of Lord Murugan written by various artists
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட அப்பன் முருகனைப் புகழ்ந்து மத பாடல்கள் மற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு.

programme.title: தினம் தினம் தரிசனம்
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the religious and spiritual significance of various Hindu temples and pilgrimage shrines across India
programme.desc: இந்தியா முழுவதும் உள்ள பல்வேறு இந்து கோவில்கள் மற்றும் புனித யாத்திரை தலங்களின் மத மற்றும் ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவம்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு சஹஸ்ரநாமம்
programme.sub-title: Hindu religious leaders and devotees chant a Sanskrit hymn listing the 1,000 names of Lord Vishnu to seek his divine blessings
programme.desc: இந்து மதத் தலைவர்களும் பக்தர்களும் விஷ்ணுவின் 1,000 நாமங்களைக் கொண்ட சமஸ்கிருத பாடலைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: ஜி‌கே‌பி / பி‌பி / டி‌டி‌எல்‌எம்
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: தொலைக்காட்சியில் சிறந்ததைக் கொண்டுவருதல்.

programme.title: மதுரை காளியம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees gather at a pious shrine to offer their sincere prayers, worship the Almighty and seek divine blessings
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் சன்னதியில் கூடி தங்கள் பிரார்த்தனைகளை வழங்கி, இறைவனை வணங்கி, தெய்வீக ஆசீகளைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு ஷேத்திரம்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees assemble to perform a ceremonial ritual, offering worship and seeking the divine blessings of Lord Vishnu
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் கூடி, ஒரு சடங்கு சடங்கை செய்து, வழிபாடு செய்து, விஷ்ணுவின் தெய்வீக ஆசீர்வாதத்தைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: பக்தி பாடல்கள்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of popular devotional songs in praise of deities performed by eminent artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: புகழ்பெற்ற கலைஞர்களால் நடத்தப்படும் தெய்வங்களைப் போற்றும் பிரபலமான பக்திப் பாடல்கள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: சத்குரு
programme.sub-title: Sadhguru, a spiritual guru, gives a discourse on the teachings from the scriptures and urges his followers to walk on the path of righteousness
programme.desc: வேதங்களிலிருந்து போதனைகள் பற்றிய சொற்பொழிவை வழங்கி, பக்தர்களை நீதியின் பாதையில் செல்ல தூண்டும் ஆன்மீக குருவான சத்குரு.

programme.title: ஸ்ரீமத் பாகவதம்
programme.sub-title: A Hindu priest from Tirumala explains the chapters from Bhagavata Purana to the devotees of Lord Krishna in a detailed manner
programme.desc: ஆன்மீகத் தலைவர் ஆழ்ந்த ஞானத்தைப் பகிர்ந்து இந்து கடவுளான கிருஷ்ணரின் வாழ்க்கையை விவரிக்கும் தகவல் உரையை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: அம்மன் கோவில்கள்
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the religious and cultural significance of various temples and shrines dedicated to Goddess Amman
programme.desc: தேவி அம்மனுக்கான பல்வேறு கோவில்கள் மற்றும் சன்னதிகளின் மத மற்றும் கலாச்சார முக்கியத்துவத்தை எடுத்துக்காட்டுகிறது.

programme.title: இஷ்ட தெய்வம்
programme.sub-title: Renowned individuals extensively discuss their faith and share experiences of divine providence and miracles in their personal lives
programme.desc: தங்கள் நம்பிக்கையை பற்றி பேசுவதோடு, அவர்களின் வாழ்வில் தெய்வீக நம்பிக்கை-அற்புதங்கள் பற்றிய அனுபவங்களை பகிரும் நபர்கள்.
