programme.desc: இளைஞர்கள்-இசைக்கலைஞர்கள் சமூக கருப்பொருள்களை வெளிப்படுத்தும் பொழுதுபோக்கு கிராமிய பாடல்களின் தொகுப்பை நிகழ்த்துகிறது.

programme.title: இஷ்ட தெய்வம்
programme.sub-title: Renowned individuals extensively discuss their faith and share experiences of divine providence and miracles in their personal lives
programme.desc: தங்கள் நம்பிக்கையை பற்றி பேசுவதோடு, அவர்களின் வாழ்வில் தெய்வீக நம்பிக்கை-அற்புதங்கள் பற்றிய அனுபவங்களை பகிரும் நபர்கள்.

programme.title: ரிலீஜியஸ் ப்ரோக்ராம்
programme.sub-title: A religious leader delivers a discourse on the teachings of the Almighty to enlighten the devotees and guide them on a path of spiritual growth
programme.desc: மத தலைவர் பக்தர்களுக்கு அறிவூட்டவும், ஆன்மீக பாதையில் வழிநடத்தவும் தேவனின் போதனைகள் குறித்த சொற்பொழிவை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: சுப்ரபாதம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional songs and hymns in praise of the divine written by various artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட தெய்வீகத்தைப் போற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்கள் மேலும் கீர்த்தனைகள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: கந்தசஷ்டிக்கவசம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of religious hymns and devotional songs in praise of Lord Murugan written by various artists
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட அப்பன் முருகனைப் புகழ்ந்து மத பாடல்கள் மற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு.

programme.title: தினம் தினம் தரிசனம்
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the religious and spiritual significance of various Hindu temples and pilgrimage shrines across India
programme.desc: இந்தியா முழுவதும் உள்ள பல்வேறு இந்து கோவில்கள் மற்றும் புனித யாத்திரை தலங்களின் மத மற்றும் ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவம்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு சஹஸ்ரநாமம்
programme.sub-title: Hindu religious leaders and devotees chant a Sanskrit hymn listing the 1,000 names of Lord Vishnu to seek his divine blessings
programme.desc: இந்து மதத் தலைவர்களும் பக்தர்களும் விஷ்ணுவின் 1,000 நாமங்களைக் கொண்ட சமஸ்கிருத பாடலைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: ஜி‌கே‌பி / பி‌பி / டி‌டி‌எல்‌எம்

programme.title: மதுரை காளியம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees gather at a pious shrine to offer their sincere prayers, worship the Almighty and seek divine blessings
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் சன்னதியில் கூடி தங்கள் பிரார்த்தனைகளை வழங்கி, இறைவனை வணங்கி, தெய்வீக ஆசீகளைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு ஷேத்திரம்

programme.title: பக்தி பாடல்கள்

programme.title: बायोनिक मैक्स
programme.sub-title: Max, a bionic guinea pig, and his goldfish best friend embark on fascinating adventures after they escape the laboratory and try to fit in the wildlife
programme.desc: एक बायोनिक गिनी पिग, मैक्स और उसके सुनहरी मछली का सबसे अच्छा दोस्त, प्रयोगशाला से भागने और वन्य जीवन में फिट होने की कोशिश करने के बाद आकर्षक रोमांच पर निकलते हैं।.

programme.title: हन्टर एक्स हन्टर
programme.sub-title: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father
programme.desc: गॉन फ्रीक्स अपने गायब पिता को खोजने की आशा एक शिकारी बनने का निश्चय करता है, जो एक विशिष्ट पेशेवर है तथा दुर्लभ राक्षसों और खजानों का शिकार करने के लिए जाना जाता है।.

programme.title: वन पीस
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: रबर से बना एक युवक मंकी डी लफी और उसके समुद्री डाकुओं की टीम एक काल्पनिक खजाने को खोजने के लिए एक रोमांचक एडवेंचर पर निकल पड़ते हैं।.

credits.actor: Mayumi Tanaka (Monkey D Luffy),Kazuya Nakai (Roronoa Zoro),Akemi Okamura (Nami),Kappei Yamaguchi (Usopp),Hiroaki Hirata (Sanji),Mahito Ôba

programme.title: कितेरेत्सु
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: कितेरेत्सु, एक प्राथमिक विद्यालय का छात्र है जो लोगों की मदद करने के लिए अपने आविष्कारों का उपयोग करता है, और कोरोसुके, उसका रोबोट, अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों में भाग लेते हैं।.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: वी बेर बीयर्स
programme.sub-title: Three brother bears, Grizzly, Panda, and Ice, awkwardly navigate life in the San Francisco Bay Area as they try to fit into modern human society
programme.desc: तीन भालू भाई, ग्रिजली, पांडा और आइस, सैन फ्रांसिस्को खाड़ी क्षेत्र में जीवन को अजीब तरीके से जीते हैं, जब वे आधुनिक मानव समाज में घुलने की कोशिश करते हैं।.

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.title: लार्वा आइलैंड
programme.sub-title: When Yellow and Red, two larvae, get stranded on an island, they use that as an opportunity to discover different things and make new animal friends
programme.desc: दो लार्वा, येलो और रेड, एक आइलैंड पर फंस जाते हैं, तो वे इसे अलग-अलग चीज़ें खोजने और नए जानवर दोस्त बनाने के मौके के तौर पर इस्तेमाल करते हैं।.

programme.title: द लार्वा आइलैंड मूवी
programme.sub-title: Chuck returns home after having an outlandish adventure with bugs, on an island where he was shipwrecked. However, he must narrate his experience to a reporter, unsure if she will believe his story
programme.desc: जहाज दुर्घटना में चक एक द्वीप पर फंस जाता है और कीड़ों के साथ एक अजीबोगरीब साहसिक के बाद घर लौटता है। हालाँकि उसे अपना अनुभव एक पत्रकार को बताना है, अनिश्चित कि वह उसकी कहानी पर विश्वास करेगी या नहीं।.

programme.title: लूनी ट्यून्स कार्टून्स
programme.sub-title: Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig, Sylvester, Tweety, Road Runner and many others go through a series of funny misadventures
programme.desc: बग्स बनी, डैफी डक, पोर्की पिग, सिल्वेस्टर, ट्वीटी, रोड रनर और कई मज़ेदार और अजीब-गरीब घटनाओं से गुज़रते हैं।.

programme.title: द जंगल बुक
programme.sub-title: Mowgli, who is raised by Akela's wolf pack, goes on daily adventures with his friends, Baloo and Bagheera. He tries to help many animals who are in danger
programme.desc: मोगली, जिसे अकेला के भेड़िया झुंड ने पाला है, अपने दोस्तों, बालू और बघीरा के साथ दैनिक रोमांच पर जाता है। वह कई जानवरों की मदद करने की कोशिश करता है जो खतरे में हैं।.

programme.title: टीन टाइटन्स गो!
programme.sub-title: A group of quirky young heroes balance crime-fighting with everyday antics, facing silly challenges, unexpected adventures and humorous situations in their unconventional world
programme.desc: नायकों का एक समूह रोज़मर्रा की हरकतों के साथ अपराध-विरोधी गतिविधियों को संतुलित करता है, अपनी अपरंपरागत दुनिया में मूर्खतापूर्ण चुनौतियों, अप्रत्याशित रोमांच और हास्यपूर्ण स्थितियों का सामना करता है।.

programme.sub-title: When Teen Titans travel to Hollywood in a bid to make their own movie, a cunning villain takes advantage of the situation and plans to take over Earth
programme.desc: टीन टाइटंस जब खुद की फिल्म बनाने के लिए हॉलीवुड की यात्रा करते हैं, तब एक चालाक खलनायक इस स्थिति का फायदा उठाता है और पृथ्वी पर कब्जा करने की योजना बनाता है।.

programme.desc: नायकों का एक समूह रोज़मर्रा की हरकतों के साथ अपराध-विरोधी गतिविधियों को संतुलित करता है, अपनी अपरंपरागत दुनिया में मूर्खतापूर्ण चुनौतियों, अप्रत्याशित रोमांच और हास्यपूर्ण स्थितियों का सामना करता है।.

programme.title: ओमी नंबर 1
programme.sub-title: Omi, an ultra-rich nine-year-old heir, encounters hilarious and eye-opening situations that teach him about the realities of life
programme.desc: ओमी, नौ साल का एक अत्यधिक अमीर वारिस है, जिसका सामना ऐसी हास्यास्पद और आंखें खोल देने वाली स्थितियों से होता है जो उसे जीवन की वास्तविकताओं के बारे में सिखाती हैं।.

programme.title: बायोनिक मैक्स
programme.sub-title: Max, a bionic guinea pig, and his goldfish best friend embark on fascinating adventures after they escape the laboratory and try to fit in the wildlife
programme.desc: एक बायोनिक गिनी पिग, मैक्स और उसके सुनहरी मछली का सबसे अच्छा दोस्त, प्रयोगशाला से भागने और वन्य जीवन में फिट होने की कोशिश करने के बाद आकर्षक रोमांच पर निकलते हैं।.

programme.title: बायोनिक मैक्स

programme.desc: एक बायोनिक गिनी पिग, मैक्स और उसके सुनहरी मछली का सबसे अच्छा दोस्त, प्रयोगशाला से भागने और वन्य जीवन में फिट होने की कोशिश करने के बाद आकर्षक रोमांच पर निकलते हैं।.

programme.title: हन्टर एक्स हन्टर
programme.sub-title: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father
programme.desc: गॉन फ्रीक्स अपने गायब पिता को खोजने की आशा एक शिकारी बनने का निश्चय करता है, जो एक विशिष्ट पेशेवर है तथा दुर्लभ राक्षसों और खजानों का शिकार करने के लिए जाना जाता है।.

programme.title: वन पीस
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: रबर से बना एक युवक मंकी डी लफी और उसके समुद्री डाकुओं की टीम एक काल्पनिक खजाने को खोजने के लिए एक रोमांचक एडवेंचर पर निकल पड़ते हैं।.

credits.actor: Mayumi Tanaka (Monkey D Luffy),Kazuya Nakai (Roronoa Zoro),Akemi Okamura (Nami),Kappei Yamaguchi (Usopp),Hiroaki Hirata (Sanji),Mahito Ôba

programme.title: कितेरेत्सु
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: कितेरेत्सु, एक प्राथमिक विद्यालय का छात्र है जो लोगों की मदद करने के लिए अपने आविष्कारों का उपयोग करता है, और कोरोसुके, उसका रोबोट, अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों में भाग लेते हैं।.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: वी बेर बीयर्स
programme.sub-title: Three brother bears, Grizzly, Panda, and Ice, awkwardly navigate life in the San Francisco Bay Area as they try to fit into modern human society
programme.desc: तीन भालू भाई, ग्रिजली, पांडा और आइस, सैन फ्रांसिस्को खाड़ी क्षेत्र में जीवन को अजीब तरीके से जीते हैं, जब वे आधुनिक मानव समाज में घुलने की कोशिश करते हैं।.

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.title: हैरी एण्ड बन्नी
programme.sub-title: Harry is an aspiring magician who invents elaborate magic tricks to impress others. However, Bunnie, his mischievous stage rabbit, constantly outsmarts him and steals his spotlight
programme.desc: हैरी एक महत्वाकांक्षी जादूगर है जो दूसरों को प्रभावित करने के लिए नए-नए जादू के खेल ईजाद करता है। हालाँकि, बन्नी, उसका नटखट खरगोश, हर बार उसे मात दे देता है और सारी वाहवाही लूट लेता है।.

programme.desc: पुजारी सुबह जल्दी उठकर पूजा का एक अनुष्ठान करते हैं, और धर्मपरायण जीवन जीने के लिए सर्वशक्तिमान से दिव्य आशीर्वाद मांगते हैं।.

programme.title: भक्ति माधुरी
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथ-प्रदर्शक सर्वशक्तिमान की शिक्षाओं पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: आनंदमय कीर्तन
programme.sub-title: Hindu religious leaders and devotees sing hymns and devotional songs and recite sacred verses to seek the blessings of the Almighty
programme.desc: हिंदू धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक और भक्तजन ईश्वर का आशीर्वाद पाने के लिए भजन और भक्ति गीत गाते हैं तथा पवित्र श्लोकों का पाठ करते हैं।.

programme.title: तुलसी आरती
programme.sub-title: A singer sings a devotional hymn in worship of Goddess Tulsi, who is regarded as an incarnation of Goddess Lakshmi, invoking the spirit of devotion
programme.desc: एक गायक देवी लक्ष्मी का अवतार मानी जाने वाली, देवी तुलसी की पूजा में भक्ति भजन गाते हैं, और भक्ति की भावना का आह्वान करते हैं।.

programme.title: श्री नरसिंह मंत्र ध्यान
programme.sub-title: A recital of the Narasimha Mantra, one of the most powerful mantras believed to protect the devotees from all kinds of evils, is played
programme.desc: नरसिंह मंत्र का जाप किया जाता है, जो सबसे शक्तिशाली मंत्रों में से एक है और ऐसा माना जाता है कि यह भक्तों को सभी प्रकार की कष्टों से बचाता है।.

programme.title: संध्या आरती इस्कॉन जुहू
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees congregate at a sacred destination to participate in a holy ritual to seek blessings from the Almighty
programme.desc: धार्मिक पथ-प्रदर्शक और भक्त सर्वशक्तिमान से आशीर्वाद लेने के लिए पवित्र अनुष्ठान में भाग लेने के लिए पवित्र स्थान पर एकत्र होते हैं।.

programme.title: योग स्टोरीज़ (हिन्दी)
programme.sub-title: Sriman Gauranga Das, a religious leader, delivers an informative discourse on yoga and explains how it benefits the body and mind
programme.desc: धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक श्रीमन गौरांग दास, योग पर एक जानकारीपूर्ण प्रवचन देते हैं और बताते हैं कि यह शरीर और मन को कैसे लाभ पहुंचाता है।.

programme.title: टेल्स ऑफ विज़डम
programme.sub-title: A religious leader elucidates key stories and verses from sacred scriptures and urges the devotees to reflect upon them in order to lead a righteous life
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथ-प्रदर्शक पवित्र शास्त्रों से प्रमुख कहानियों और छंदों को स्पष्ट करते हैं और भक्तों से एक धार्मिक जीवन जीने के लिए उन पर चिंतन करने के लिए कहते हैं।.

programme.title: धाम यात्रा
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the mythological significance of a pilgrimage to the sacred destinations of the followers of Hinduism
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथ-प्रदर्शक हिंदू धर्म के अनुयायियों के पवित्र स्थलों की तीर्थयात्रा के पौराणिक महत्व के बारे में बताते हैं।.

programme.title: योग स्टोरीज़ (इंग्लिश)
programme.sub-title: A spiritual leader delivers an insightful talk on unity and diversity, urging the devotees to identify their limitations and depend on others for support
programme.desc: एक आध्यात्मिक पथप्रदर्शक एकता और विविधता पर व्यावहारिक प्रवचन देते हैं तथा भक्तों से अपनी सीमाओं को पहचानने और सहायता के लिए दूसरों से मदद लेने का आग्रह करते हैं।.

programme.title: नेक्टर वर्सेस

programme.desc: एक धार्मिक और धर्मशास्त्रीय विद्वान श्रीमद् भागवतम पुराण के श्लोकों के गहन अर्थों को स्पष्ट करते हुए इसके आध्यात्मिक ज्ञान का खुलासा करते हैं।.

programme.title: அபிராமி

programme.title: திரை தென்றல்
programme.sub-title: The host engages in a meaningful conversation with the viewers and plays Tamil movie songs on their requests
programme.desc: பார்வையாளர்களுடன் உரையாடலில் ஈடுபட்டு, அவர்களுடைய வேண்டுகோளின் பேரில் தமிழ் திரைப்படப் பாடல்களை வழங்கும் தொகுப்பாளர்.

programme.title: சுகமான ராகங்கள்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of popular melodious songs composed and performed by various renowned artists played back to back
programme.desc: பல்வேறு புகழ்பெற்ற கலைஞர்களால் இசையமைக்கப்பட்டு நிகழ்த்தப்பட்ட பிரபலமான மெல்லிசைப் பாடல்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு.

programme.title: பக்தி பாடல்கள்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of popular devotional songs in praise of deities performed by eminent artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: புகழ்பெற்ற கலைஞர்களால் நடத்தப்படும் தெய்வங்களைப் போற்றும் பிரபலமான பக்திப் பாடல்கள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: Tirupati Navaratri Brahmotsavam
programme.desc: Tirupati Navaratri Brahmotsavam.

programme.title: ஆன்மீக கதைகள்
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on various teachings and principles from the Hindu scriptures and encourages followers to reflect on the same
programme.desc: இந்து வேதங்களிலிருந்து பல போதனைகள் மற்றும் கொள்கைகளை விளக்கி பக்தர்களை அதைப் பற்றி சிந்திக்க ஊக்குவிக்கும் மதத் தலைவர்.

programme.title: நல்ல காலம் பிறக்குது
programme.sub-title: A renowned astrologer provides a comprehensive insight into the position of stars and makes astrological predictions for the 12 zodiac signs
programme.desc: ஒரு பிரபல ஜோதிடர் நட்சத்திரங்களின் நிலையை பற்றிய விரிவான நுண்ணறிவை அளிப்பதோடு, 12 ராசிகளுக்கும் கணிப்புகளை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: நியூஸ்
programme.sub-title: The host provides the latest information, advancements, and developments regarding various political, economic and social issues
programme.desc: அரசியல், பொருளாதார மற்றும் சமூகப் பிரச்சினைகள் தொடர்பான சமீபத்திய தகவல்கள், முன்னேற்றங்கள் மற்றும் முன்னேற்றங்கள்.

programme.title: வணக்கம் தமிழா
programme.sub-title: The hosts interact with renowned personalities and also present the latest updates from across the globe, ranging from entertainment to technology
programme.desc: தொகுப்பாளர்கள் பிரபல ஆளுமைகளுடன் தொடர்பு கொண்டு, உலகம் முழுவதிலுமிருந்து சமீபத்திய புதுப்பிப்புகளையும் வழங்குகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: ராமாயணம்
programme.sub-title: Lord Rama and various other figures in Valmiki's Ramayana and Tulsidas's 'Ramcharitmanas' go through trials and tribulations to achieve their goals and protect their loved ones
programme.desc: ராமர் இலக்குகளை அடையவும், தங்கள் அன்புக்குரியவர்களைப் பாதுகாக்கவும் சோதனைகள் மற்றும் இன்னல்களைக் கடந்து செல்கின்றனர்.

programme.title: எதிர்நீச்சல்
programme.sub-title: Janani and the women of the household embark on a journey to pursue their ambitions in the wake of Aadhimuthu Gunasekaran's downfall, while navigating the challenges of society
programme.desc: சமூகத்தின் சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, தங்கள் லட்சியங்களைத் தொடர ஜனனியும் வீட்டுப் பெண்களும் ஒரு பயணத்தைத் தொடங்குகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: கயல்
programme.sub-title: Kayal, a selfless woman, earns to provide for her family after her father abandons them. Despite being overwhelmed with responsibilities, she puts her loved ones' well-being before her own happiness
programme.desc: தந்தைக்கு பின் குடும்ப பொறுப்புகளில் மூழ்கியுள்ள கயல், மகிழ்ச்சியை விட அன்புக்குரியவர்களின் நலனையே முன்னிறுத்துகிறாள்.

programme.title: கிச்சன் கலாட்டா
programme.sub-title: The host welcomes celebrity guests as they whip up their signature dishes alongside high-end chef creations, rustic village recipes and much more
programme.desc: விருந்தினர்கள் தங்களின் தனித்துவமான உணவுகளையும், சமையல் கலைஞர்களின் படைப்புகளையும், கிராமிய பாரம்பரிய சமையல் குறிப்புகளையும் மற்றும் பலவற்றையும் தயாரிக்கும்போது, ​​தொகுப்பாளர் அவர்களை வரவேற்கிறார்.

programme.title: பூங்கொடி
programme.sub-title: Poongodi's quest for self-establishment leads her to Saravanan, a man unwittingly controlled by his stepmother's manipulative ways
programme.desc: பூங்கொடியின் சுய தேடல் அவளை தன் மாற்றாந்தாயின் சூழ்ச்சிகளால் அறியாமலேயே கட்டுப்படும் சரவணனிடம் அழைத்துச் செல்கிறது.

programme.title: துளசி
programme.sub-title: A kind-hearted Tulasi strives hard to keep her family together and secure the happiness, well-being and future of her children at all costs
programme.desc: குடும்பத்தை ஒன்றாக வைத்துகொள்ளவும், குழந்தைகளின் மகிழ்ச்சி, நல்வாழ்வு மேலும் எதிர்காலத்தை பாதுகாக்கவும் பாடுபடும் துளசி.

programme.title: குறிஞ்சி
programme.sub-title: When circumstances compel an ambitious woman to wed a man with a tough personality, their initial friction slowly gives way to mutual understanding and eventually love
programme.desc: சூழ்நிலைகளின் நிர்ப்பந்தத்தால், லட்சியம் மிக்க ஒரு பெண், கடின குணமுடைய ஒரு ஆணை மணக்கிறாள். ஆரம்பகால முரண்பாடுகள் படிப்படியாக மறைந்து, பரஸ்பர புரிதலுக்கும் இறுதியில் காதலுக்கும் வழிவகுக்கிறது.

programme.title: அபிராமி
programme.sub-title: Abirami, a loving mother and devoted wife, places her family's happiness above all else. After enduring endless disrespect, she, with her daughter's support, sets out to rebuild her life
programme.desc: அன்பான தாயும் மனைவியுமான அபிராமி, தன் குடும்பத்தின் மகிழ்ச்சிக்கே முன்னுரிமை அளிக்கிறாள். எனினும், தொடர் அவமரியாதைகளை சந்தித்த பின், அவள் தன் மகளின் ஆதரவுடன் தன் வாழ்க்கையை மீண்டும் புதிதாகத் தொடங்குகிறாள்.

programme.title: சிறகுகள்

programme.desc: கடினமான குடும்பச் சிக்கல்களைச் சமாளிக்கும் வேளையில், பேராசையையும் துரோகத்தையும் எதிர்கொள்ளும் தர்மதுரையையும் பார்வதியையும் விதி ஒன்று சேர்க்கிறது.

programme.title: శ్రీ లలితా సహస్రనామ స్తోత్రం
programme.sub-title: Professional singers perform a rendition of a devotional song, reciting the thousand names of Goddess Lalita, seeking her blessings
programme.desc: వృత్తిపరమైన గాయకులు లలితాదేవి వెయ్యి నామాలను పఠిస్తూ భక్తి గీతాన్ని ఆలపిస్తూ, ఆమె ఆశీర్వాదాలు కోరుకుంటారు.

programme.title: గణపతి స్తోత్రం
programme.sub-title: Several devotees gather to chant the Ganpati Stotram, a devotional chant, in praise of Lord Ganesha and seek his blessings
programme.desc: అనేకమంది భక్తులు కలిసి భక్తి శ్లోకమైన గణపతి స్తోత్రంతో వినాయకుడిని ఆరాధిస్తూ, స్వామి ఆశీర్వాదాలు కోరతారు.

programme.title: యాదాద్రి సుప్రభాతం
programme.sub-title: Hindu priests and devotees chant a comprehensive compilation of hymns in praise of Yadagiri Laxmi Narasimha Swamy to seek the blessings of the Almighty
programme.desc: పండితులు, భక్తులు యాదగిరి లక్ష్మీ నరసింహస్వామిని స్తుతిస్తూ ఆయన దీవెనలు పొందేందుకు కీర్తనల సంకలనాన్ని పఠిస్తారు.

programme.title: కాకడ హారతి
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees gather together to sing devotional hymns and perform sacred rituals in honour of Shirdi Sai Baba
programme.desc: షిర్డీ సాయిబాబా గౌరవార్థం ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువులు, భక్తులు ఒకచోట చేరి శ్లోకాలు పఠిస్తూ, పవిత్రమైన ఆచారాలను నిర్వహిస్తారు.

programme.title: శ్రీ వెంకటేశ్వర సుప్రభాతం
programme.sub-title: In veneration of Lord Venkateswara, devotees and priests listen to devotional songs and perform religious customs in order to seek his blessings
programme.desc: పండితులు, భక్తులు శ్రీ వెంకటేశ్వర స్వామివారి కృపాకటాక్షాలు కోరుతూ మతపరమైన ఆచారాలను నిర్వహించి, భక్తి గీతాలు ఆలపిస్తారు.

programme.title: శ్రీ విష్ణు సహస్రనామ స్తోత్రం
programme.sub-title: Devotees recite the Sri Vishnu Sahasranama Stotram, in the name of Lord Vishnu to seek blessings and lead a better prosperous life
programme.desc: భక్తులు మెరుగైన, సంపన్న జీవితాన్ని ప్రసాదించమని కోరుతూ, విష్ణువు నామాలతో కూడిన విష్ణు సహస్రనామ స్తోత్రాన్ని పఠిస్తారు.

programme.title: శ్రీరామ సుప్రభాతం
programme.sub-title: An all-encompassing collection of sacred and soulful hymns that are composed and performed at dawn to celebrate and praise Lord Rama
programme.desc: శ్రీరాముడిని స్తుతించడానికి, జరుపుకోవడానికి తెల్లవారుజామున కూర్చి పాడే పవిత్రమైన, మనోహరమైన శ్లోకాల యొక్క సమగ్ర సేకరణ.

programme.title: ఆంజనేయ సహస్రనామం
programme.sub-title: A Sanskrit hymn listing the 1,000 names of Lord Hanuman is recited to appease the Hindu deity and seek his divine blessings
programme.desc: ఆంజనేయ స్వామి వేయినామలతో కూడిన సంస్కృత శ్లోకం హిందూ దేవతను ప్రసన్నం చేసుకోవడానికి, ఆశీర్వాదాలను పొందేందుకు పఠిస్తారు.

programme.title: హనుమాన్ అభిషేకం
programme.sub-title: Hindu religious leaders and devotees participate in sacred rituals while chanting holy hymns to seek blessings from Lord Hanuman
programme.desc: ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువులు మరియు భక్తులు హనుమంతుడి ఆశీర్వాదం పొందడానికి పవిత్ర స్తోత్రాలను పఠిస్తూ పవిత్ర ఆచారాలలో పాల్గొంటారు.

programme.title: యాదాద్రి అభిషేకం
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees chant sacred prayers and hymns while performing a ritual to seek blessings from the Almighty
programme.desc: ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువులు, భక్తులు భగవంతుడి కృపాకటాక్షాలను కోరుతూ శ్లోకాలను పఠిస్తూ, ఆచార వ్యవహారాలతో ప్రత్యేక పూజలు చేస్తారు.

programme.title: जॉय ऑफ कृष्णा कान्शसनस
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees sing devotional songs and offer their sincere prayers to Lord Krishna, seeking his divine blessings
programme.desc: धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक और भक्तजन भजन गाते हैं और भगवान कृष्ण से सच्चे मन से प्रार्थना करते हुए उनका दिव्य आशीर्वाद मांगते हैं।.

programme.title: डिवोशनल मेलोज़
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional hymns and songs are played back to back, praising the Almighty and seeking divine blessings
programme.desc: भक्ति भजनों और गीतों का एक व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, जिसमें ईश्वर की स्तुति की जाती है और दिव्य आशीर्वाद की कामना की जाती है।.

programme.title: மிஸ் யூ
programme.sub-title: An aspiring director falls in love with a woman under unusual circumstances and crosses paths with a dangerous politician
programme.desc: ஒரு ஆர்வமுள்ள இயக்குனர் அசாதாரண சூழ்நிலையில் ஒரு பெண்ணைக் காதலித்து, ஒரு ஆபத்தான அரசியல்வாதியைச் சந்திக்கிறார்.

credits.actor: Siddharth (Vasu),Ashika Ranganath (Subbulakshmi),Balasaravanan,Karuna Karan,Anupama Parameswaran,V. Jayaprakash,Ponvannan,Lollu Sabha Maaran

programme.title: இந்தவார கலகலப்பு
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of hilarious comedy scenes, featuring popular artists, is played back-to-back for the entertainment of the viewers
programme.desc: கலைஞர்கள் பங்கேற்கும் நகைச்சுவைக் காட்சிகளின் தொகுப்பு பார்வையாளர்களின் பொழுதுபோக்கிற்காக தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: சொன்னா புரியாது
programme.sub-title: Shiva, a dubbing artist, loathes love and marriages. His mother blackmails him to marry Anjali who appears to be a spiritual girl, but he later finds out that she is exactly opposite in her character
programme.desc: ஆன்மீகவாதியை போல நடிக்கும் அஞ்சலியை மணக்கும்படி அவனது தாயாரால் மிரட்டப்படும் சிவா, அவள் குணத்தை பற்றி அறிந்துகொள்கிறார்.

credits.actor: Shiva (Shiva),Vasundhara Kashyap (Anjali),Blade Shankar (Shiva's friend),Pradeep K Vijayan (Bimbo),Jacqueline (Shwetha),Jangiri Madhumitha,R.S. Shivaji (Anjali's father),Manobala (Rajesh Khanna),Gangai Amaran (TV Show Host),Vathsala Rajagopal (Shiva's grandmother)

programme.title: பிக் கேட்ஸ் ஸ்மால் வர்ல்ட்
programme.sub-title: Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba are teaching their cubs survival skills whilst keeping them out of the jaws of big male cats
programme.desc: போட்ஸ்வானாவின் கோமோட்டி நதியில் தங்கி தங்கள் திறமைகளால் போட்டியாளர்களை தடுக்கும் மூன்று பெரிய பூனை குடும்பங்கள்.

programme.title: இத்தாலி : தி லாஸ்ட் வில்டர்னஸ் இயர் 1
programme.sub-title: The biological cycle of Abruzzi's chamois, which are endemic to the highest mountains of Central Italy. The Apennine chamois are an ancient species, but today, they are under serious threat. They are the survivors of a prehistoric species
programme.desc: ஐரோப்பாவின் மையப்பகுதியில் உள்ள டானூப் நதிக்கரை காடுகளின் சுற்றுச்சூழல் அமைப்பில் செழித்து வளரும் வனவிலங்கு வாழ்விடம்.

programme.title: ஐபீரியன் வைப்பர்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Exploring the behaviour, unique characteristics, and survival strategies of venomous vipers in the Iberian Peninsula
programme.desc: ஐபீரிய தீபகற்பத்தில் உள்ள விஷ பாம்புகளின் நடத்தை, பண்புகள் மற்றும் உயிர்வாழும் உத்திகளை ஆராயும் திரைப்பட தயாரிப்பாளர்.

programme.title: டைகரஸ் ப்ளட்
programme.sub-title: Tigers in general are believed to be solitary hunters. But in the forests of Central India, a gang of females learned to hunt co-operatively, taking down large, dangerous prey
programme.desc: ஒரு புலி கூட்டம் எவ்வாறு வேட்டையாடுகிறது என்பதற்கான விதிகளை மாற்றி எழுதும் மத்திய இந்தியாவின் நான்கு புலிகளின் வாழ்க்கை.

programme.title: நேச்சுரல் பார்ன் மான்ஸ்டர்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Sean Duggan travels to Thailand to investigate the giant snakehead fish in its native habitat. Sean's expedition takes him from Thailand to snakehead-infested Arkansas to see if this killer fish can be stopped
programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures - from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles - in `Natural Born Monsters'. When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.

programme.title: அ கேம் ஆஃப் லெப்பர்ட் த்ரோன்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Filmed over ten years, an in-depth look at the leopard characters of South Africa and their fascinating unfolding story once their Queen dies
programme.desc: சாபி சாண்ட்ஸ் கேம் ரிசர்வில் தங்களுடைய 12 ஆண்டுகால ராணி மறைந்த பிறகு, மேலாதிக்கத்திற்காக சண்டையிடும் சிறுத்தைகள்.

programme.title: Heroines of The Savannah
programme.desc: Following the lives of three matriarchs from the animal kingdom and showing the valuable role of leading females in wildlife.

programme.title: அனிமல் அட்டாக் ரேட்
programme.sub-title: The filmmakers shed light on some of the deadliest predators in Australia, including reptiles and arachnids with unique biological weapons
programme.desc: பல்வேறு விலங்குகளின் தாக்கும் உள்ளுணர்வும் அவற்றின் தனித்துவமான அம்சங்களைப் பற்றிய நுண்ணறிவையும் விளக்கும் ஆவணப்படம்.

programme.title: ஸ்னோ லெப்பர்ட்ஸ் வித் டான் ஓ'நீல்
programme.sub-title: Navigating the harsh Mongolian wilderness with Dan O'Neill as he searches for 'The Dude', the largest snow leopard ever recorded
programme.desc: உயிரியலாளரும் இயற்கை ஆர்வலருமான டான் ஓ நீல், ஆராய்ச்சி மையத்தை உருவாக்கி பனிச்சிறுத்தையை பற்றி ஆய்வு செய்ய முயலுகிறார்.

programme.title: Turtle Walker
programme.desc: In the 1970s, Satish Bhaskar documented sea turtle nesting sites along India's coasts, helping protect the species. The 2004 tsunami later threatened their habitats.

programme.title: டைகரஸ் ப்ளட்
programme.sub-title: Tigers in general are believed to be solitary hunters. But in the forests of Central India, a gang of females learned to hunt co-operatively, taking down large, dangerous prey
programme.desc: ஒரு புலி கூட்டம் எவ்வாறு வேட்டையாடுகிறது என்பதற்கான விதிகளை மாற்றி எழுதும் மத்திய இந்தியாவின் நான்கு புலிகளின் வாழ்க்கை.

programme.title: Fight For Life
programme.desc: Discover the story of the rehabilitation of an African national park. After the first step of successfully acclimatising herbivores, it is time to reintroduce lions. But with them comes predation, and suddenly, fear overtakes the park.

programme.title: லோவென் கெகன் ஹ்யானென்
programme.sub-title: A year has passed since the lionesses of the Boulder Pride bore their cubs. The youngsters have got much bigger and, amazingly, all nine have survived. But the lions in the northern savannah on the border of Kenya and Tanzania have a problem
programme.desc: சிங்கங்கள் மற்றும் கழுதைப்புலிகளின் நடத்தையை ஆராய்ந்து, அவற்றின் போட்டியைப் பற்றிய முன்கூட்டிய கருத்துக்களை கூறுகிறது.

programme.title: ஸ்னோ லெப்பர்ட்ஸ் வித் டான் ஓ'நீல்
programme.sub-title: Navigating the harsh Mongolian wilderness with Dan O'Neill as he searches for 'The Dude', the largest snow leopard ever recorded
programme.desc: உயிரியலாளரும் இயற்கை ஆர்வலருமான டான் ஓ நீல், ஆராய்ச்சி மையத்தை உருவாக்கி பனிச்சிறுத்தையை பற்றி ஆய்வு செய்ய முயலுகிறார்.

programme.title: லவ் வைல்ட்
programme.sub-title: Some of the animal kingdom's wildest courtships and mating rituals
programme.desc: விலங்கு உறவுகளின் அம்சங்களோடு போட்டியான இனச்சேர்க்கை, சண்டைகள் முதல் கூட்டுறவு நட்பு-குடும்ப உறவுகள் வரை காட்டுகிறது.

programme.title: பிக் கேட்ஸ் ஸ்மால் வர்ல்ட்
programme.sub-title: Track Molelo's pride, who are exhausted when the winter floods arrive, and witness a scary encounter that gives leopard mum Sephiri a decision to make

programme.title: ரேஸ் ஆஃப் லைஃப்
programme.sub-title: Desert animals have evolved to handle heat and lack of water. This includes scorpions, which have existed since life first crawled from the sea
programme.desc: சூழலில் தழுவி, விலங்குகளிடமிருந்து தங்களை பாதுகாக்க காலப்போக்கில் உருவாகிய பல்வேறு உயிரினங்களை பற்றி கூறும் தொகுப்பாளர்.

programme.title: இத்தாலி : தி லாஸ்ட் வில்டர்னஸ் இயர் 1

programme.desc: ஐரோப்பாவின் மையப்பகுதியில் உள்ள டானூப் நதிக்கரை காடுகளின் சுற்றுச்சூழல் அமைப்பில் செழித்து வளரும் வனவிலங்கு வாழ்விடம்.

programme.title: நேச்சுரல் பார்ன் மான்ஸ்டர்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Sean travels to Costa Rica and comes face-to-face with a monster born from the jungle, the Brazilian Wandering Spider
programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures - from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles - in `Natural Born Monsters'. When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.

programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures - from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles - in `Natural Born Monsters'. When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.

programme.title: சர்வைவிங் ஆஸ்திரேலியா
programme.sub-title: Aussies who've survived the fury of nature and encountered deadly threats in their own backyard share their stories as the country's suburban residents increasingly find themselves in the vicinity of dangerous wildlife
programme.desc: ஆஸ்திரேலிய வனப்பகுதியிலிருந்து தப்பிப் பிழைத்தவர்களின் அனுபவங்களையும், அங்கு உயிர் பிழைக்கத் தேவையான நடைமுறை உத்திகளையும் இந்த ஆவணப்படம் விவரிக்கிறது.

programme.title: சர்வைவிங் ஆஸ்திரேலியா
programme.sub-title: Discover what it takes to survive the heat in one of the world's sunniest and driest countries, where almost half the island is uninhabitable and summer bush fires cripple the nation

programme.title: அ கேம் ஆஃப் லெப்பர்ட் த்ரோன்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Filmed over ten years, an in-depth look at the leopard characters of South Africa and their fascinating unfolding story once their Queen dies
programme.desc: சாபி சாண்ட்ஸ் கேம் ரிசர்வில் தங்களுடைய 12 ஆண்டுகால ராணி மறைந்த பிறகு, மேலாதிக்கத்திற்காக சண்டையிடும் சிறுத்தைகள்.

programme.title: லேக் லைஃப்: சீக்ரெட்ஸ் பினீத் தி சர்ஃபேஸ்
programme.desc: Dive beneath the surface to explore rare species, geological wonders and unique ecosystems in Germany's and Austria's most stunning lakes.

programme.sub-title: Explores the interesting facets, physical features, behaviours and habitats of a wide variety of animal species
programme.desc: பல்வேறு வகையான விலங்கு இனங்களின் சுவாரஸ்யமான உடல் அம்சங்கள், நடத்தைகள் மற்றும் வாழ்விடங்களை ஆராயும் திரைப்பட இயக்குனர்.

programme.title: த ஜூ
programme.sub-title: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals
programme.desc: பிராங்க்ஸ் மிருகக்காட்சிசாலையில் விலங்குகளின் பராமரிப்பு, அழியும் உயிரினங்களை காப்பதில் ஊழியரின் அர்ப்பணிப்பை அறிக.

credits.actor: Jim Breheny,John Sykes,Annie Rivas,Kathleen LaMattina,Pat Thomas,Colleen McCann

programme.title: க்ரிகீ! இட்'ஸ் த இர்வினிஸ்
programme.sub-title: Carrying on late wildlife conservationist Steve Irwin's mission to bring people closer to animals is now the mission of his family. Terri, Bindi and Robert Irwin return to Animal Planet, giving viewers access to their wildlife adventures around the world and the amazing animals that continue to inspire their conservation efforts. The series features the family caring for more than 1,200 animals at the Australia Zoo; overseeing a world-class wildlife hospital, the largest of its kind in the world; and conducting high-level global expeditions
programme.desc: விலங்குகளை கவனித்துக்கொள்ள ஆஸ்திரேலிய பூங்காவில் வேலை செய்யும் இர்வின் குடும்பத்தினர் பல போராட்டங்களை எதிர்கொள்கின்றனர்.

programme.title: ஜுவல்ஸ் ஆஃப் த நேச்சுரல் வர்ல்ட்
programme.sub-title: Explores stunning natural landscapes and how animals act on their protective and fierce nature to survive and reproduce
programme.desc: உலகின் பல்வேறு பகுதிகளிலிருந்து வனவிலங்குகளை ஆராய்ந்து அவற்றின் பாதுகாப்பு மற்றும் கடுமையான தன்மையை விளக்கும் இயக்குனர்.

programme.sub-title: WILD BY NATURE is a television series about wild nature, which deals with the endemic fauna of Mexico, narrated from a fresh, intrepid, and original point of view with a message of conservation and care for our species. programme.sub-title: From the makers of Earth's Greatest Rivers, Earth's Tropical Islands journeys to three of the most exotic, mysterious and remote islands on planet Earth: Madagascar, Borneo and Hawaii. In three episodes, the series reveals how these isolated and iconic tropical islands harbour remarkable wildlife and human castaways found nowhere else on Earth. Madagascar is the oldest island in the world, Borneo cradles more diversity of life than any other island, and Hawaii is the remotest island chain in the world. In a rapidly changing world, these fragile islands are a vital gauge for the health of our planet

programme.sub-title: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals
programme.desc: பிராங்க்ஸ் மிருகக்காட்சிசாலையில் விலங்குகளின் பராமரிப்பு, அழியும் உயிரினங்களை காப்பதில் ஊழியரின் அர்ப்பணிப்பை அறிக.

programme.title: శివ
programme.sub-title: Shiva is a brave and intelligent child who stays with his grandparents in Vedas City. He sets out with his gang of friends to save the citizens from all sorts of evil
programme.desc: వేదాస్ నగరంలో తన బామ్మాతాతాలతో నివసించే ధైర్యంగల శివ, మిత్రులతో కలిసి తన నగరాన్ని దుష్ట శక్తుల నుండి కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Nilufer Middey,Sonal Kaushal,Rupa Bhimani,Anamay Verma,Aditya Jaiswal,Brij Bhushan Sawhney,Manoj Pandey

programme.title: పాక్ పకావు
programme.sub-title: Follow the whimsical and absurd conversations of two friends and learn new things as they navigate life's everyday mysteries
programme.desc: ఇద్దరు స్నేహితుల విచిత్రమైన, మరియు అసంబద్ధమైన సంభాషణలను అనుసరించండి మరియు వారు జీవితంలోని కొత్త విషయాలను నేర్చుకోండి.

programme.title: పక్డమ్ పక్డై
programme.sub-title: There is a constant war between Doggy Don and the three clever mice who live in his house. However, with the help of Doggy Don's brother, an ex-army dog, they fight the mice to win back their house
programme.desc: తన ఇంట్లో మూడు ఎలుకలతో నిరంతరం యుద్ధం చేసే డాగీ డాన్, మాజీ ఆర్మీ కుక్కతో కలిసి తమ ఇంటిని సొంతం చేసుకోడానికి పోరాడతాడు.

programme.title: జిగ్ అండ్ షార్కో
programme.sub-title: Zig the hyena lives all alone on a desert island and schemes to eat Marina
programme.desc: జిగ్ అనే హైనా, మెరీనా అనే మత్స్యకన్యను తినడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తుంది, కానీ ఆమె మిత్రుడు షార్కో ఆమెని జిగ్ నుండి కాపాడతాడు.

credits.director: Olivier Jean-Marie,Andrés Fernández,Cédric Dietsch,Khalil Ben Naamane,Yani Ouabdesselam,Nicolas Bougard,Pierre-Gilles Stehr

programme.title: పక్డమ్ పక్డాయి: ఎటాక్ ఆన్ టోక్యో
programme.sub-title: Facing his biggest battle yet, Doggy Don pairs up with Colonel to stand in the way of Samurai Gong, saving Tokyo from a disastrous attack
programme.desc: డాగీ డాన్, అతని అన్నయ్య కార్నెల్, జపాన్‌లోని టోక్యో నగరంలో విధ్వంసం సృష్టించాలనుకునే దుష్ట శక్తులతో పోరాడుతారు.

programme.title: జిగ్ అండ్ షార్కో
programme.sub-title: Zig the hyena lives all alone on a desert island and schemes to eat Marina

programme.title: భూత్ బంధుస్ అండ్ ద పవర్ ఆఫ్ త్రీ
programme.sub-title: A ghost family raises an abandoned baby boy, Pinaki, at the Vibhooti Mansion in the Modern City. Things take a humorous turn when he attends public school and gets exposed to the real world
programme.desc: విభూతి భవనంలో దెయ్యాల కుటుంబంలో పెరిగిన పినాకి, ప్రభుత్వ పాఠశాలలో చేరినప్పుడు వాస్తవ ప్రపంచాన్ని ఎదుర్కొంటాడు.

programme.title: పినాకి అండ్ హ్యాపీ -ది భూత్ బంధుస్
programme.sub-title: Pinaki and his family of ghosts embark on spooky adventures and a series of fun and slapstick comedy as they try to fit in the outside world
programme.desc: పినాకి, అతని దెయ్యాల కుటుంబం బయటి ప్రపంచంలో ఇమిడిపోవడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తూ, భయానక సాహసాలు, హాస్య సంఘటనల పరంపరలో పయనిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Sonal Kaushal,Rajesh Kava,Manoj Pandey,Aranya Kaur,Pawan Kalra,Meghna Erande,Bhakti Jhaveri,Pooja Punjabi

programme.title: పాక్ పకావు
programme.sub-title: Follow the whimsical and absurd conversations of two friends and learn new things as they navigate life's everyday mysteries
programme.desc: ఇద్దరు స్నేహితుల విచిత్రమైన, మరియు అసంబద్ధమైన సంభాషణలను అనుసరించండి మరియు వారు జీవితంలోని కొత్త విషయాలను నేర్చుకోండి.

programme.title: పక్డమ్ పక్డై
programme.sub-title: There is a constant war between Doggy Don and the three clever mice who live in his house. However, with the help of Doggy Don's brother, an ex-army dog, they fight the mice to win back their house
programme.desc: తన ఇంట్లో మూడు ఎలుకలతో నిరంతరం యుద్ధం చేసే డాగీ డాన్, మాజీ ఆర్మీ కుక్కతో కలిసి తమ ఇంటిని సొంతం చేసుకోడానికి పోరాడతాడు.

programme.title: పినాకి అండ్ హ్యాపీ -ది భూత్ బంధుస్
programme.sub-title: Pinaki and his family of ghosts embark on spooky adventures and a series of fun and slapstick comedy as they try to fit in the outside world
programme.desc: పినాకి, అతని దెయ్యాల కుటుంబం బయటి ప్రపంచంలో ఇమిడిపోవడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తూ, భయానక సాహసాలు, హాస్య సంఘటనల పరంపరలో పయనిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Sonal Kaushal,Rajesh Kava,Manoj Pandey,Aranya Kaur,Pawan Kalra,Meghna Erande,Bhakti Jhaveri,Pooja Punjabi

programme.title: జిగ్ అండ్ షార్కో
programme.sub-title: Zig the hyena lives all alone on a desert island and schemes to eat Marina
programme.desc: జిగ్ అనే హైనా, మెరీనా అనే మత్స్యకన్యను తినడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తుంది, కానీ ఆమె మిత్రుడు షార్కో ఆమెని జిగ్ నుండి కాపాడతాడు.

credits.director: Olivier Jean-Marie,Andrés Fernández,Cédric Dietsch,Khalil Ben Naamane,Yani Ouabdesselam,Nicolas Bougard,Pierre-Gilles Stehr

programme.title: डेरिंग गुंडाराज
programme.sub-title: Jagan falls for Sunanda, who happens to be the daughter of his father's business rival. Further hilarity ensues when the two tycoons unknowingly broker a match between their love-struck children
programme.desc: जगन, सुनंदा से प्यार करने लगता है, जो उसके पिता के व्यापारिक प्रतिद्वंद्वी की बेटी है। मजेदार स्थिति उत्पन्न होती है, जब दोनों व्यवसायी अनजाने में अपने बच्चों का रिश्ता तय कर देते हैं।.

programme.title: प्रिंस नं. 1
programme.sub-title: Raja falls in love with Rani but breaks off the relationship due to family pressure. Later, when he has all but given up hope of seeing her again, he gets a surprise
programme.desc: राजा को रानी से प्यार हो जाता है, लेकिन पारिवारिक दबाव के कारण वह रिश्ता तोड़ देता है। बाद में, जब उसे उससे दोबारा मिलने की उम्मीद लगभग खत्म हो जाती है, तब उसे एक सरप्राइज मिलता है।.

credits.actor: Mahesh Babu (Raj Kumar/Raja \"Shaktiman\"),Preity Zinta (Rani),Prakash Raj (Dhanunjay/Dhanraj),Jayaprakash (Sarvarayudu),Sumalatha (Rajlakshmi),Srihari (Narsimharayudu),Krishna (Krishnamurthy/Bhisambher),Brahmanandam (Sub-Inspector Wagle),MS Narayana (Policeman),Govardhan Asrani (Police Inspector),Mink Singh (Special Appearance),Teja Sajja (Vengalla Rayudu)

programme.title: मेहरबान
programme.sub-title: Ravi promises his father on his deathbed that he will take care of Chaurangilal's family whenever the need arises. However, a cunning Chaurangilal concocts a plan to leave Ravi bankrupt and take over his wealth
programme.desc: रवि अपने मरणासन्न पिता से वादा करता है कि वह चुरंगीलाल और उसके परिवार की देखभाल करेगा। हालाँकि, चुरंगीलाल, रवि के पैसों को चुराने और उसे कंगाल करने की साजिश रचता है।.

credits.actor: Mithun Chakraborty,Ayesha Jhulka,Shanti Priya,Sadashiv Amrapurkar,Anupam Kher,Ajinkya Deo,Kader Khan,Sulabha Deshpande

programme.title: वीआईपी 2 ललकार
programme.sub-title: A businesswoman is enraged when a civil engineer declines her job offer. With revenge on her mind, she decides to make his life troublesome
programme.desc: एक व्यवसायी महिला तब क्रोधित हो जाती है जब एक सिविल इंजीनियर उसकी नौकरी की पेशकश ठुकरा देता है। बदला लेने के इरादे से वह उसकी ज़िंदगी मुश्किल बनाने का फैसला करती है।.

programme.title: संगीली बुंगिली दरवाज़ा खोल
programme.sub-title: Vasu and his mother move into a bungalow they have recently purchased on the outskirts of town. However, they discover the presence of certain supernatural forces
programme.desc: वासु और उसकी माँ शहर के बाहरी इलाके में हाल ही में खरीदे गए एक बंगले में रहने आते हैं। हालाँकि, उन्हें कुछ पारलौकिक शक्तियों की मौजूदगी का पता चलता है।.

credits.actor: Jiiva,Sri Divya,Radha Ravi,Soori,Radhika Sarath Kumar,Thambi Ramaiah,Madhumila

programme.title: देवरा: पार्ट 1
programme.sub-title: A fierce sea warrior violently opposes his village's criminal activities, while years later, his gentle son charts his own course, creating a stark contrast in paths
programme.desc: एक क्रूर समुद्री योद्धा अपने गाँव की आपराधिक गतिविधियों का हिंसक विरोध करता है, जबकि सालों बाद, उसका पुत्र अपना रास्ता स्वयं बनाता है, जिससे दोनों के बीच विपरीत स्थिति उत्पन्न होती है।.

credits.actor: N.T. Rama Rao Jr. (Devara/Vara),Saif Ali Khan (Bhaira),Janhvi Kapoor (Thangam),Prakash Raj (Singappa),Meka Srikanth (Rayappa),Shine Tom Chacko (Kora),Insane Ashraf,Ramya Krishnan

programme.title: युद्ध एक जंग
programme.sub-title: Chandu, a supermarket employee, encounters trouble after he decides to help Indu, an aspiring actor. But when he gets embroiled in a murder case, a dark secret from his past resurfaces
programme.desc: एक सुपरमार्केट कर्मचारी चंदू मुसीबत में पड़ जाता है जब वह एक महत्वाकांक्षी अभिनेत्री इंदु की मदद करने का फैसला करता है, और एक हत्या के मामले में उलझ जाता है।.

credits.actor: Nandamuri Balakrishna,Anjali,Sonal Chauhan,Vikramjeet Virk,Suman,Nassar,Rati Agnihotri,Nawab Shah

programme.title: सप्तगिरि एक्सप्रेस
programme.sub-title: A happy-go-lucky actor is forced to do his father's job after his unexpected demise. However, when he realises his father was murdered, he sets out to exact vengeance
programme.desc: बेफ़िक्र अभिनेता सप्तगिरि, पिता की मौत के बाद उनकी जगह पर नौकरी करने के लिए मजबूर होता है। लेकिन, जल्द ही उसे पता चलता है कि उसके पिता की हत्या की गई थी और वह बदला लेने का फैसला करता है।.

credits.actor: Saptagiri (Saptagiri),Roshini Prakash (Poornima),Ali,Shakalaka Shankar (Kaanipaakam),Posani Krishna Murali,Sayaji Shinde,Ajay Ghosh

programme.title: दशहरा
programme.sub-title: In a town that is dependent on coal mining, the lives of three childhood friends turn chaotic when they get into a fight with the son of the village headman
programme.desc: कोयला खनन पर निर्भर एक कस्बे में, तीन बचपन के दोस्तों की ज़िंदगी तब अस्त-व्यस्त हो जाती है जब उनका गांव के मुखिया के बेटे से झगड़ा हो जाता है।.

credits.actor: Nani (Dharani),Keerthy Suresh (Vennela),Dheekshith Shetty (Siddham Suryam \"Suri\"),Shine Tom Chacko (Thurpugutta Chinna Nambi),Samuthirakani (Chinna Nambi's father),Raghu Babu (Babu Reddy)

programme.title: डेयर डेविल
programme.sub-title: A fierce rivalry ensues between a boxer and a gangster who believes that the former is in love with his sister. Eventually, the boxer goes to extreme lengths to clear the rivalry and prove his love
programme.desc: एक मुक्केबाज और एक गैंगस्टर के बीच भयंकर दुश्मनी शुरू हो जाती है, जिसे लगता है कि मुक्केबाज उसकी बहन से प्यार करता है। अंततः, मुक्केबाज इस दुश्मनी को खत्म करने के लिए, अपने प्यार को साबित करता है।.

credits.actor: Vishnu Manchu,Taapsee Pannu,Prakash Raj,Raghu Babu,Sayaji Shinde,Jagapathi Babu,Adivi Sesh

programme.title: ईवारू
programme.sub-title: Sameera Maha kills a top police officer and claims self-defence, which leads to a complex legal battle. An investigator uncovers dark secrets that connect their lives and reveal a web of deceit
programme.desc: पुलिस इंस्पेक्टर विक्रम को उस वरिष्ठ अधिकारी के हत्यारे को पकड़ने का काम सौंपा जाता है, जिसने समीरा के साथ कथित तौर पर बलात्कार किया है। जाँच शुरू करने पर वह कई स्याह रहस्यों का सामना करता है।.

credits.actor: Regina Cassandra,Adivi Sesh,Naveen Chandra,Murali Sharma,Nihal Kodhaty,Pavitra Lokesh,Thimmareddy Baitinti,Kousi Orfahli

programme.title: आज का नया खिलाड़ी

programme.desc: வழிபாட்டின் முக்கியத்துவம் பற்றி பகிர்ந்து, கடவுளின் ஆசிளை பெற்று நோக்கமுள்ள வாழ்வை வாழ்வது பற்றி பேசும் ஆன்மீக தலைவர்.

programme.title: கண்ணான கண்மணிகளே
programme.sub-title: Short and moral stories from the Bible are narrated for the children and videos of young viewers reciting holy verses and singing devotional songs are presented
programme.desc: குழந்தைகளுக்காக பைபிளிலிருந்து நெறி கதைகளை விவரிக்கப்படுவதோடு, பார்வையாளர்கள் பக்தி பாடல்களை பாடுவது போன்ற வீடியோக்கள்.

programme.title: புத்தகம் பேசுகிறது
programme.sub-title: The host engages in conversations with authors of motivational books, reading excerpts from their works while exploring their journeys and personal experiences
programme.desc: தொகுப்பாளர் ஆசிரியர்களின் பயணங்கள் மற்றும் அனுபவங்களை ஆராய்வதோடு அவர்களின் படைப்புகளிலிருந்து சில பகுதிகளை படிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: வந்ததும் தந்ததும்
programme.sub-title: A religious leader delivers a detailed discourse on the various facets of God, prayer and worship while encouraging devotees to lead a faithful life
programme.desc: கடவுள், பிரார்த்தனை மற்றும் வழிபாட்டின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி பிரசங்கித்து, நேர்மையாக வாழ பக்தர்களை ஊக்குவிக்கும் மத தலைவர்.

programme.title: அன்றாட உணவு
programme.sub-title: A Christian leader shares inspiring teachings on faith, spirituality and applying biblical principles to daily life, offering guidance for a deeper connection with God
programme.desc: நம்பிக்கை, ஆன்மீகம் பற்றிய போதனைகள், வாழ்க்கையில் வேதாகமக் கொள்கைகளைப் பயன்படுத்துதல் பற்றி பகிரும் கிறிஸ்தவ தலைவர்.

programme.title: பிரேயர்ஸ் அண்ட் சாங்க்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: The rendering of ancient hymns and songs composed in praise of the Almighty is played in order to invoke the spirit of devotion
programme.desc: பழங்காலப் பாடல்கள் மற்றும் சர்வவல்லவரை புகழ்ந்து இயற்றப்பட்ட பாடல்கள் பக்தி உணர்வைத் தூண்டும் வகையில் இசைக்கப்படுகின்றன.

programme.title: ஏஞ்சலஸ்
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: தொலைக்காட்சியில் சிறந்தவைகள்.

programme.title: ஹோலி மாஸ்
programme.sub-title: A religious leader conducts a service for a group of devotees to follow along in unison and offer their prayers to the Almighty
programme.desc: மதத் தலைவர், பக்தர்கள் குழு ஒன்று ஒற்றுமையாக இறைவனிடம் தங்கள் பிரார்த்தனைகளைச் செய்ய ஒரு சேவையை நடத்துகிறார்.

programme.title: எடுத்து வாசி

programme.desc: கிறுஸ்துவ பாதிரியார் பைபிளிலிருந்து வாசகம் படித்து அதன் வரலாற்று, இலக்கிய மற்றும் தத்துவ முக்கியத்துவத்தை விளக்குகிறார்.

programme.title: அவர் பெயர் மரியா

programme.title: లిటిల్ కృష్ణ
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna, a mischievous child, lives in the village of Vrindavan. He decides to save the villagers from an evil king, Kamsa, who sends ferocious demons upon them
programme.desc: కొంటెవాడైన చిన్ని కృష్ణుడు, ప్రజలపైకి భయంకర రాక్షసులను పంపిన దుష్ట కంసుడి నుండి బృందావన ప్రజలను కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Prachi Save Saathi,Meghna Erande,Neil D'Monte,Anand Tiwari,Vikrant Chaturvedi,Soniya Nair,Cara Pareira

programme.title: లిటిల్ కృష్ణ మెడ్లీస్
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna has fun getting caught up in all sorts of mischief with his friends in Vrindavan. But when the evil Kansa sends his minions to disrupt his life, he jumps into action
programme.desc: బృందావనంలో తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి అల్లరి చేస్తూ సరదాగా తిరిగే శ్రీకృష్ణుడు, కంసుడి రాక్షసులను అంతం చేయడానికి సిద్దమవుతాడు.

programme.desc: నిజాయితీగల, ధైర్యవంతుడైన పోలీసు అధికారి సింబా, తన సహచరులతో కలిసి సమాజంలోని దుష్ట శక్తులను ఎదుర్కొవాలనుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur
programme.desc: చాలా ధైర్యవంతుడు, బలమైన, తెలివైన బాలుడు భీమ్, ఢోలక్‌పూర్‌ పట్టణవాసుల సమస్యలన్నింటినీ పరిష్కరించగలుగుతాడు.

credits.actor: Vatsal Dubey (Chhota Bheem),Julie Tejwani (Raju),Rupa Bhimani (Chutki),Sabina Malik Mausam (Kalia),Rajesh Kava (Jaggu),Prince Patel (Takiya)

programme.title: జై జగన్నాథ్
programme.sub-title: The host shines light on the annual chariot procession held in the honour of Lord Jagannath in Puri, Odisha, which is attended by numerous devotees from all over the country
programme.desc: ఒడిశాలోని పూరీలో జగన్నాథ స్వామి గౌరవార్థం జరిగే వార్షిక రథోత్సవంపై వివరిస్తారు, దేశం నలుమూలల నుండి భక్తులు హాజరవుతారు.

programme.title: లిటిల్ సింగం
programme.sub-title: Little Singham, an honest but ferocious police officer, fights against injustice and defends his town from formidable enemies
programme.desc: నిజాయితీపరుడైన పోలీసు అధికారి లిటిల్ సింగం అన్యాయానికి వ్యతిరేకంగా పోరాడుతూ, శత్రువుల నుండి తన పట్టణాన్ని కాపాడతాడు.

credits.actor: Swapnil Kumari,Jigna Bharadhwaj,Sonal Kaushal,Neshma Chemburkar,Ganessh Divekar,Shaily Dubey,Saumya Daan,Anamaya Verma,Sumrridhi Shukla

programme.title: గ్రిజ్జీ అండ్ ద లెమ్మింగ్స్
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్జీ అనే ఎలుగుబంటి ఒక అటవీ రేంజర్ ఇంటిని తన సొంత నివాసంగా భావిస్తుంది, అయితే లెమ్మింగ్స్ రాకతో పరిస్థితి మారుతుంది.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.desc: గ్రిజ్జీ అనే ఎలుగుబంటి ఒక అటవీ రేంజర్ ఇంటిని తన సొంత నివాసంగా భావిస్తుంది, అయితే లెమ్మింగ్స్ రాకతో పరిస్థితి మారుతుంది.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.title: సంపత్ చంపత్
programme.sub-title: Follow the hilarious misadventures of Sampat and Champat, two bumbling thieves who constantly hatch chaotic plans that backfire, landing them in endless trouble with the local police
programme.desc: సంపత్, చంపత్ అనే ఇద్దరు చేతకాని దొంగలు నిరంతరం స్థానిక పోలీసుల చిక్కుల్లో పడే హాస్యభరితమైన సాహసాలను అనుసరించండి.

programme.title: లిటిల్ సింగం జెట్ సెట్ అడ్వెంచర్
programme.sub-title: When an evil monster abducts Mantriji and forcibly takes him to Hawaii, Little Singham gets into action to rescue Mantriji and annihilate the wicked forces
programme.desc: లిటిల్ సింగం, అతడి బృందం బందీగా ఉన్న ఒక ప్రముఖ వ్యక్తిని కాపాడడానికి వివిధ దేశాలకు సాహసయాత్ర యాత్రకు వెళతారు.

programme.title: లిటిల్ సింగం జెట్ సెట్ అడ్వెంచర్
programme.sub-title: Little Singham embarks on an adventurous journey from Cambodia to Japan in order to safely bring back the prime minister of Mirchi Nagar home
programme.desc: లిటిల్ సింగం, అతడి బృందం బందీగా ఉన్న ఒక ప్రముఖ వ్యక్తిని కాపాడడానికి వివిధ దేశాలకు సాహసయాత్ర యాత్రకు వెళతారు.

programme.sub-title: Little Singham, a ferocious young police officer, embarks on an adventurous journey from Ecuador to Norway to rescue a distinguished personality
programme.desc: లిటిల్ సింగం, అతడి బృందం బందీగా ఉన్న ఒక ప్రముఖ వ్యక్తిని కాపాడడానికి వివిధ దేశాలకు సాహసయాత్ర యాత్రకు వెళతారు.

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్ కృష్ణ వర్సెస్ జింబారా
programme.sub-title: Chhota Bheem and Krishna join forces to stop Zimbara, who wants to establish his supremacy over Earth by freeing his brother, Kirmada, from the world of darkness
programme.desc: ఛోటా భీమ్, కృష్ణ కలిసి చీకటి ప్రపంచం నుండి కిర్మదాను విడిపించి, భూమిపై ఆధిపత్యం చేయాలనుకునే జింబారాను అడ్డుకుంటారు.

credits.actor: Jigna Bhardwaj,Rupa Bhimani,Vatsal Dubey,Rajesh Kava,Julie Tejwani

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur

credits.actor: Vatsal Dubey (Chhota Bheem),Julie Tejwani (Raju),Rupa Bhimani (Chutki),Sabina Malik Mausam (Kalia),Rajesh Kava (Jaggu),Prince Patel (Takiya)

programme.title: Material Witness
programme.desc: The FBI suspects' fraudulent business practices are linked to the mysterious disappearance of Candor Diamond Corporation president, Irwin Margolies. Weeks after Margolies turns up, and begins cooperating with authorities, several Candor employees are now the victims of brutal murders. The deaths all point to the work of a hired hit man, with possible links to Margolies, but it will take the concentrated efforts of federal agents to untangle the web of clues to convict the killers.

credits.actor: Mark Joy (Donald Nash),Carl Burrows,Keith Michael Gregory,Michael McKennitt,Tim L. Smith

programme.title: Monsters and Mysteries
programme.desc: Whether the protagonist is a Batsquatch, Skunk Ape, Mothman or Chupacabra, tales of mysterious creatures and unexplainable phenomena have been passed down generations. \"Monsters and Mysteries in America\" takes a trip across the U.S. to reveal the most cryptic, frightening and brow-furrowing stories. Each hourlong episode focuses on a specific region and the lore of residents who claim to have encountered legendary monsters, ancient spirits or alien beings. With America's dense forests, desert grasslands, and hundreds of miles of uninhabitable wilderness, could it really house -- or hide -- so many mysterious creatures?

programme.title: The Prosecutors: In Pursuit of Justice
programme.desc: Real-life criminal cases prosecuted by attorneys.

programme.title: World of Travel
programme.desc: TV host Lindsey Granger, filmmaker Kolyn Boyd, and their young daughter, Kynsley, embark on adventures, discovering eateries, unique stays and experiencing various international cultures.

programme.title: हनी बनी
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: बब्लू डबलू
programme.sub-title: An evil logger decides to turn the forest into his personal lumberyard. However, things change after Bablu and Dablu, two bear brothers, decide to stop him
programme.desc: एक दुष्ट लकड़हारा जंगल को अपना निजी लकड़हारा बनाने का फ़ैसला करता है। लेकिन, दो भालू भाइयों, बबलू और डबलू, द्वारा उसे रोकने के फ़ैसले के बाद चीज़ें बदल जाती हैं।.

programme.title: हनी बनी
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: जंगल बुक
programme.sub-title: Mowgli, a young boy, is raised in the jungle by wolves. He has two loyal friends, Bagheera, a panther, and Baloo, a bear, who safeguard him from Shere Khan, a Bengal tiger, who wants to devour Mowgli
programme.desc: एक छोटा लड़का मोगली, जंगल में भेड़ियों के बीच पला-बढ़ा है। उसके दो वफादार दोस्त हैं, बघीरा (एक तेंदुआ), और बल्लू (एक भालू), जो उसे शेर खान (एक बंगाल टाइगर) से बचाते हैं, जो मोगली को खाना चाहता है।.

programme.title: 12 ज्योतिर्लिंग दर्शन
programme.sub-title: Devotees come together to participate in a pilgrimage to visit the 12 Jyotirlingas, which are considered a divine manifestation of Lord Shiva
programme.desc: भक्तगण 12 ज्योतिर्लिंगों के दर्शन हेतु तीर्थयात्रा में भाग लेने के लिए एकत्रित होते हैं, जिन्हें भगवान शिव का दिव्य स्वरूप माना जाता है।.

programme.title: धर्म कथा
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, ईश्वर की शिक्षाओं पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: भक्ति प्रवाह
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of ancient hymns and spiritual verses chanted in order to praise the Almighty is played back to back
programme.desc: यह कार्यक्रम, परमेश्वर की स्तुति के लिए संगीतबद्ध किए गए प्राचीन भजनों और आध्यात्मिक छंदों का व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: भूत बॉस (पाप-ओ-मीटर)
programme.sub-title: Bhoot Boss, Thakela and Pakela are ghosts who seek out people that have sinned and teach them a lesson to reduce wrongdoings in the world. However, their mission lands them in precarious situations
programme.desc: भूत बॉस, थकेला और पकेला भूत हैं जो पाप करने वाले लोगों को ढूंढ उन्हें सबक सिखाते हैं। हालांकि, उनका मिशन उन्हें अनिश्चित परिस्थितियों में डाल देता है।.

programme.title: जानबाज़ मुर्गा
programme.sub-title: A fun-loving chicken along with his friends embark on various adventures, as they overcome challenges and share heartfelt moments
programme.desc: एक मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला मुर्गा अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों पर निकलता है, जहां वे चुनौतियों पर विजय प्राप्त करते हैं और दिल को छू लेने वाले पल साझा करते हैं।.

programme.title: जीजा जी छत पर है
programme.sub-title: Elaichi's mischievous antics keep her father Murari on edge, while Pancham, secretly in love with her, navigates hilarious mishaps due to his hidden marital status
programme.desc: इलायची की शरारतें उसके पिता मुरारी को परेशान रखती हैं, जबकि पंचम, जो मन ही मन इलायची से प्यार करता है, अपनी छुपी हुई वैवाहिक स्थिति के कारण हास्यास्पद घटनाओं से गुजरता है।.

programme.sub-title: Four brave female police officers of Aminabad police station use their wittiness and emotional intelligence to tackle the various challenges they face at their work

programme.title: 12 ज्योतिर्लिंग दर्शन
programme.sub-title: Devotees come together to participate in a pilgrimage to visit the 12 Jyotirlingas, which are considered a divine manifestation of Lord Shiva
programme.desc: भक्तगण 12 ज्योतिर्लिंगों के दर्शन हेतु तीर्थयात्रा में भाग लेने के लिए एकत्रित होते हैं, जिन्हें भगवान शिव का दिव्य स्वरूप माना जाता है।.

programme.title: धर्म कथा
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, ईश्वर की शिक्षाओं पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: भक्ति प्रवाह
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of ancient hymns and spiritual verses chanted in order to praise the Almighty is played back to back
programme.desc: यह कार्यक्रम, परमेश्वर की स्तुति के लिए संगीतबद्ध किए गए प्राचीन भजनों और आध्यात्मिक छंदों का व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: भूत बॉस (पाप-ओ-मीटर)
programme.sub-title: Bhoot Boss, Thakela and Pakela are ghosts who seek out people that have sinned and teach them a lesson to reduce wrongdoings in the world. However, their mission lands them in precarious situations
programme.desc: भूत बॉस, थकेला और पकेला भूत हैं जो पाप करने वाले लोगों को ढूंढ उन्हें सबक सिखाते हैं। हालांकि, उनका मिशन उन्हें अनिश्चित परिस्थितियों में डाल देता है।.

programme.title: जानबाज़ मुर्गा
programme.sub-title: A fun-loving chicken along with his friends embark on various adventures, as they overcome challenges and share heartfelt moments
programme.desc: एक मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला मुर्गा अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों पर निकलता है, जहां वे चुनौतियों पर विजय प्राप्त करते हैं और दिल को छू लेने वाले पल साझा करते हैं।.

programme.desc: एक छोटा लड़का मोगली, जंगल में भेड़ियों के बीच पला-बढ़ा है। उसके दो वफादार दोस्त हैं, बघीरा (एक तेंदुआ), और बल्लू (एक भालू), जो उसे शेर खान (एक बंगाल टाइगर) से बचाते हैं, जो मोगली को खाना चाहता है।.

programme.title: बब्लू डबलू
programme.sub-title: An evil logger decides to turn the forest into his personal lumberyard. However, things change after Bablu and Dablu, two bear brothers, decide to stop him
programme.desc: एक दुष्ट लकड़हारा जंगल को अपना निजी लकड़हारा बनाने का फ़ैसला करता है। लेकिन, दो भालू भाइयों, बबलू और डबलू, द्वारा उसे रोकने के फ़ैसले के बाद चीज़ें बदल जाती हैं।.

programme.title: हनी बनी
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: 12 ज्योतिर्लिंग दर्शन
programme.sub-title: Devotees come together to participate in a pilgrimage to visit the 12 Jyotirlingas, which are considered a divine manifestation of Lord Shiva
programme.desc: भक्तगण 12 ज्योतिर्लिंगों के दर्शन हेतु तीर्थयात्रा में भाग लेने के लिए एकत्रित होते हैं, जिन्हें भगवान शिव का दिव्य स्वरूप माना जाता है।.

programme.title: धर्म कथा
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, ईश्वर की शिक्षाओं पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: भक्ति प्रवाह
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of ancient hymns and spiritual verses chanted in order to praise the Almighty is played back to back
programme.desc: यह कार्यक्रम, परमेश्वर की स्तुति के लिए संगीतबद्ध किए गए प्राचीन भजनों और आध्यात्मिक छंदों का व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: हनी बनी
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: जांबाज मुर्गा
programme.sub-title: A trio of chickens resides on a lively farm. Meanwhile, two mischievous weasels from a chaotic junkyard plot to make a meal out of them
programme.desc: एक खेत में रहने वाली मुर्गियों की एक तिकड़ी को एक अव्यवस्थित कबाड़खाने में रहने वाले दो शरारती नेवले अपना भोजन बनाने की योजना बनाते हैं।.

programme.title: पीटर पैन
programme.sub-title: Peter Pan embarks on various adventures with his friends to fight the evil Captain Hook and his pirates and save Neverland
programme.desc: पीटर पैन एक दुष्ट कैप्टन हुक और उसके समुद्री डाकुओं से लड़ने और नेवरलैंड्स को बचाने के लिए अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों पर निकलता है।.

programme.title: जीजाजी छत पर हैं
programme.sub-title: Pancham and Pintu disguise themselves as a married couple in a desperate attempt to find a house and succeed in renting Murari's attic. However, Murari's daughter, Elaichi, learns about their secret
programme.desc: पंचम और पिंटू किराए के मकान के लिए मुरारी के सामने पति-पत्नी होने का नाटक करते हैं। हालांकि, मुरारी की बेटी इलायची को उनके रहस्य के बारे में पता चल जाता है।.

programme.title: मद्दाम सर
programme.sub-title: Four brave female police officers of Aminabad police station use their wittiness and emotional intelligence to tackle the various challenges they face at their work
programme.desc: अमीनाबाद पुलिस स्टेशन की चार बहादुर महिला पुलिस अधिकारी अपने कार्यस्थल की विभिन्न चुनौतियों से निपटने के लिए अपनी बुद्धिमता और भावनात्मक बुद्धिमत्ता का उपयोग करती हैं।.

programme.title: रॉबिनहुड
programme.sub-title: After Baron Alwyn's men set fire to the palace of the Huntingtons, young Robert, along with his friend and sisters, seeks refuge in Sherwood Forest. There, they meet the leader of a group of outlaws
programme.desc: बैरन एल्विन के आदमियों द्वारा हंटिंगटन के महल में आग लगाने के बाद, रॉबर्ट अपने दोस्त और बहनों के साथ शेरवुड फ़ॉरेस्ट में शरण लेता है। वहाँ, वे डाकूओं के एक समूह के नेता से मिलते हैं।.

programme.title: ஆசை 100 வகை
programme.sub-title: A series of dramatised re-enactments of cases revolving around various horrifying and unscrupulous activities that conspire in society
programme.desc: சமூகத்தில் சதி செய்யும் பல்வேறு திகிலூட்டும் மற்றும் நேர்மையற்ற செயல்களைச் சுற்றியுள்ள வழக்குகளின் தொடர்ச்சியான நாடகமாக்கப்பட்ட மறு-நடவடிக்கைகள்.

programme.title: மிக்ஸ்டேப் பாடல்கள்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of some of the most popular and beloved musical numbers from the year, played consecutively
programme.desc: வருடத்தில் மிகவும் பிரபலமான மற்றும் பிரியமான சில இசை எண்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு, தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்பட்டது.

programme.title: Baal Krishna
programme.desc: Krishna, the young son of Devaki and Vasudeva, embarks on a series of adventures where he befriends the people of Vrindavan, his hometown, and saves them from difficulties.

credits.actor: Nimai Bali,Meet Mukhi,Sachin Shroff,Deshna Dugad,Ram Awana

programme.title: கணபதியே வருவாய்
programme.sub-title: After Lord Shiva beheads Ganesha, Goddess Parvati asks for his resurrection with an elephant's head. Despite facing many challenges after this, Ganesha transforms from an ostracized child into the most beloved deity
programme.desc: சிவன் கணேசனின் தலையை துண்டித்த பிறகு, பார்வதி தேவி யானை தலையுடன் மீண்டும் உயிர்ப்பிக்குமாறு கோரியபின், சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, கணேசன் ஒதுக்கப்பட்ட குழந்தையிலிருந்து மிகவும் விரும்பப்படும் தெய்வமாகிறார்.

programme.title: கால பைரவன்
programme.sub-title: Jogeshwari is the daughter of Dakshan who hates Shiva and worships Vishnu. When Dakshan forces Jogeshwari to marry, she rebels because of her dedication towards Bhairavan, a devout devotee of Shiva
programme.desc: சிவனை வெறுத்து விஷ்ணுவை வழிபடும் தட்சன், அவரது மகள் ஜோகேஸ்வரியை திருமணம் செய்ய வற்புறுத்தும்போது, அவளோ சிவனின் தீவிர பக்தரான பைரவன் மீதான தனது பக்தியின் காரணமாக எதிர்க்கிறாள்.

programme.title: மூவி
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: திரைப்படங்களில் சிறந்தவை.

programme.title: அண்ணாமலை
programme.sub-title: Generations of rivalry come to light as two families fight for control of a revered temple while personal emotions complicate the path to peace
programme.desc: தனிப்பட்ட உணர்வுகள் அமைதிக்கான பாதையை சிக்கலாக்கும் அதே வேளையில், ஒரு புனிதமான கோவிலின் கட்டுப்பாட்டிற்காக இரண்டு குடும்பங்கள் சண்டையிடுவதால், தலைமுறையாக இருந்துவரும் அவர்களின் பகைமை வெளிச்சத்திற்கு வருகிறது.

credits.actor: Sivakumar,Radikaa Sarathkumar,Shyam Ganesh,Kuyili,Ponvannan,Viji Chandrasekhar,Shanmuga Sundaram,Jyothi Lakshmi

programme.title: தாமரை
programme.sub-title: Sneha and Dwarkesh fall in love, and they secretly register their marriage. However, their relationship is tested as they face various obstacles
programme.desc: காதலர்களான சினேகாவும் துவாரகேஷும் ரகசியமாக பதிவு திருமணம் செய்து கொள்கிறார்கள். ஆனால், அவர்கள் பல்வேறு தடைகளைச் சந்திக்கும் பொழுது அவர்களின் உறவு சோதிக்கப்படுகிறது.

credits.director: K.J Thangapandiyan,Hafees,A. Ramachandran,M.K. Arunthavaraja,S. Anand Babu

programme.title: Selvi
programme.desc: Selvi, a young girl, has academic ambition that she wants to pursue by moving to the city from her village. However, her family wants her to get married.

programme.title: அம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Sakthi is blessed by the Goddess Amman with the power to foresee the future. Her life takes an unexpected turn when she meets an atheist doctor
programme.desc: அம்மன் தேவியால் சக்தி எதிர்காலத்தை கணிக்கும் அருளை பெறுகிறாள். அவள் ஒரு நாத்திக மருத்துவரை சந்திக்கும்போது, அவளது வாழ்க்கை எதிர்பாராத திருப்பத்தை அடைகிறது.

programme.title: கணபதியே வருவாய்

programme.title: బిగ్ క్యాట్స్ స్మాల్ వరల్డ్
programme.sub-title: Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba are teaching their cubs survival skills whilst keeping them out of the jaws of big male cats
programme.desc: మూడు పెద్ద పిల్లి కుటుంబాలు ఉమ్మడి స్థలంలో సహజీవనం చేస్తూనే ప్రత్యర్థులను అధిగమించడానికి వారి నైపుణ్యాలను ఉపయోగిస్తాయి.

programme.title: సీక్రెట్స్ ఆఫ్ ది ఫ్లడెడ్ ఫారెస్ట్
programme.sub-title: The biological cycle of Abruzzi's chamois, which are endemic to the highest mountains of Central Italy. The Apennine chamois are an ancient species, but today, they are under serious threat. They are the survivors of a prehistoric species

programme.sub-title: Cameras reveal the last secrets of Africa's largest wild lions by following two prides
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు సెరెంగేటిలో వాతావరణ మార్పుల మధ్య మనుగడ కోసం పోరాడుతున్న సింహం, చిరుత జాతుల జీవితాల గురించి చూపుతారు.

programme.title: Tiger 24
programme.desc: Follows the story of a wild tiger jailed after killing a forest guard, igniting a nationwide debate in India. Through cinematic imagery and first-hand accounts, see justice, conservation, and how humans choose to coexist with predators.

programme.title: రేస్ అఫ్ లైఫ్
programme.sub-title: Crocodiles are descended from animals that roamed Earth 250 million years ago, while snakes rely on the sun to control their temperature
programme.desc: స్వీయ ర‌క్ష‌ణ‌లో భాగంగా పరిసరాలకు అనుగుణంగా అభివృద్ధి చెందిన జంతువుల గురించి వ్యాఖ్యాత వివ‌రిస్తారు.

programme.title: ఇటలీ: ది లాస్ట్ వైల్డర్‌నెస్
programme.sub-title: Like wrinkles on an old face, ravines mark the calcareous plateaus in the very south of Italy, connecting the arid lands of Lucania and Puglia to the blue sea of Magna Grecia
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు, ఇటలీలోని అరుదైన పర్యావరణ వ్యవస్థలను అన్వేషిస్తూ, మనుగడ కోసం పోరాడుతున్న జంతువుల కథలను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: వోల్వ్స్: పవర్ ఆఫ్ ది ప్యాక్
programme.sub-title: From the arctic tundra to the great plains, the kingdom of the wolf extends across the entire northern hemisphere. They are icons of the wilderness, spectacular creatures that live and die by the sword
programme.desc: ఆర్కిటిక్ టండ్రా నుండి విశాల మైదానాల వరకు, తోడేళ్ల సామ్రాజ్యం ఉత్తరార్ధగోళం అంతటా విస్తరించి ఉంది. ఇవి అరణ్యానికి ప్రతీకలు.

programme.title: స్నో లెపర్డ్స్ విత్ డాన్ ఓనీల్‌
programme.sub-title: Prowling the heart of Central Asia with biologist and naturalist Dan O'Neill as he races against time searching for the enigmatic snow leopard
programme.desc: ప్రకృతి, జీవ శాస్త్రవేత్త అయిన డాన్ ఓనీల్, ఒక పరిశోధనా కేంద్రాన్ని నిర్మించి, మంచు చిరుతపులిపై అధ్యయనం చేస్తారు.

programme.title: సర్వైవింగ్ ఆస్ట్రేలియా
programme.sub-title: Aussies who've survived the fury of nature and encountered deadly threats in their own backyard share their stories as the country's suburban residents increasingly find themselves in the vicinity of dangerous wildlife

programme.desc: Mediterranean Hunters.

programme.title: న్యాచురల్ బార్న్ మాన్‌స్టర్స్
programme.sub-title: Sean Duggan travels to Thailand to investigate the giant snakehead fish in its native habitat. Sean's expedition takes him from Thailand to snakehead-infested Arkansas to see if this killer fish can be stopped
programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures - from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles - in `Natural Born Monsters'. When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.

programme.sub-title: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals

programme.sub-title: Explores stunning natural landscapes and how animals act on their protective and fierce nature to survive and reproduce

programme.title: క్రికీ! ఇట్స్ ద ఇర్విన్స్
programme.sub-title: Carrying on late wildlife conservationist Steve Irwin's mission to bring people closer to animals is now the mission of his family. Terri, Bindi and Robert Irwin return to Animal Planet, giving viewers access to their wildlife adventures around the world and the amazing animals that continue to inspire their conservation efforts. The series features the family caring for more than 1,200 animals at the Australia Zoo; overseeing a world-class wildlife hospital, the largest of its kind in the world; and conducting high-level global expeditions

programme.title: ఎర్త్స్ ట్రాపికల్ ఐలాండ్స్
programme.sub-title: From the makers of Earth's Greatest Rivers, Earth's Tropical Islands journeys to three of the most exotic, mysterious and remote islands on planet Earth: Madagascar, Borneo and Hawaii. In three episodes, the series reveals how these isolated and iconic tropical islands harbour remarkable wildlife and human castaways found nowhere else on Earth. Madagascar is the oldest island in the world, Borneo cradles more diversity of life than any other island, and Hawaii is the remotest island chain in the world. In a rapidly changing world, these fragile islands are a vital gauge for the health of our planet
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు మడగాస్కర్, బోర్నియో, హవాయిలోని అన్యదేశ, మారుమూల ద్వీపాలలో మానవ జనాభా, వన్యప్రాణుల చరిత్రను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.desc: దర్శకుడు భారతదేశ అపరిమితమైన ప్రకృతి దృశ్యాలలో నివసించే విభిన్న వన్యప్రాణుల గురించి అంతర్దృష్టిని అందించారు.

programme.title: జస్ట్ యానిమల్స్
programme.sub-title: Explores the interesting facets, physical features, behaviours and habitats of a wide variety of animal species
programme.desc: చిత్ర దర్శకుడు అనేక రకాల జంతువుల ఆవాసాలు, భౌతిక లక్షణాలు, ప్రవర్తనలు, ఆసక్తికర విషయాలను విశ్లేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ బై నేచర్
programme.sub-title: WILD BY NATURE is a television series about wild nature, which deals with the endemic fauna of Mexico, narrated from a fresh, intrepid, and original point of view with a message of conservation and care for our species. Our protagonist, the actor and naturalist Arturo Islas travels through the going into their jungles, deserts, and seas in search of the wonderful species of fauna: mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, fish, and insects. WILD BY NATURE is a great experience of adventure and knowledge of natural wealth
programme.desc: నటుడు, ప్రకృతి శాస్త్రవేత్త ఆర్థర్ ఇస్లాస్ అనేక రకాల జంతువుల ఆవాసాలు, వాటికి సంబంధించిన ఆసక్తికర విషయాలను పంచుకుంటారు.

programme.title: ద జూ
programme.sub-title: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు అంతరించిపోతున్న జాతులను రక్షించడంలో, వన్యప్రాణులను సంరక్షించడానికి బ్రాంక్స్ జూ చేస్తున్న ప్రయత్నాలను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: క్రికీ! ఇట్స్ ద ఇర్విన్స్
programme.sub-title: Carrying on late wildlife conservationist Steve Irwin's mission to bring people closer to animals is now the mission of his family. Terri, Bindi and Robert Irwin return to Animal Planet, giving viewers access to their wildlife adventures around the world and the amazing animals that continue to inspire their conservation efforts. The series features the family caring for more than 1,200 animals at the Australia Zoo; overseeing a world-class wildlife hospital, the largest of its kind in the world; and conducting high-level global expeditions
programme.desc: ఆస్ట్రేలియా జంతుశాలలో పనిచేస్తున్న ఇర్విన్ కుటుంబ సభ్యులు జంతువులను జాగ్రత్తగా చూసుకోవడానికి అనేక ఇబ్బందులు పడతారు.
