programme.desc: Pratap travels to Mumbai for better career opportunities. He gains success and falls in love with the daughter of his boss. On the day of his engagement, Pratap gets arrested for a murder.

programme.title: Kshatriya
programme.desc: The royal families of Mirtagarh and Surjangarh are at war with each other. Problems arise when their respective younger generations refuse to continue the feud.

programme.title: Bade Ghar Ki Beti
programme.desc: Mala, a virtuous girl, marries into a wealthy family. She faces opposition from her jealous sisters-in-law but eventually wins their hearts with her kindness and resilience.

programme.title: Majhdhaar
programme.desc: Krishna loves Radha but they cannot marry against their parent's wishes. Although she is pregnant with Krishna's child, circumstances lead Radha to marry Gopal.

programme.title: Comedy Station - Dr Pran Lele
programme.desc: DR PRAN LELE, A quirky, mad-cap doctor - Dr. Pran Lele along with his crazy Nurse CPR is here to provide an abundant dose of LOLs & ROFLs as they treat their celebrity patients in their unique ways.

programme.title: Jannat
programme.desc: A gambler turns into a cricket bookie banking on his sixth sense for the game. But his urge to make quick money pushes him into match fixing and he loses control of his life and love.

programme.title: Bade Dilwala
programme.desc: A man upsets his wife by splitting a winning lottery ticket with a waitress.

programme.title: Naughty @ 40
programme.desc: Happy, a 40-year-old, marries Gauri, a childlike woman, and frustration leads him into the arms of a model. When Gauri finds out about their relation, she decides to change her attitude.

programme.title: Ilzaam
programme.desc: After Aarti's father disapproves of Ajay as his future son-in-law, he suddenly disappears from her life. Years later they meet again, but Aarti is shocked to find the truth behind his disappearance.

programme.title: Har Dil Jo Pyar Karega
programme.desc: Raj, Pooja and Jhanvi are in a complicated love triangle. Pooja and Jhanvi love Raj. Raj loves Jhanvi but is misunderstood as Pooja's husband by their family. How will the confusion clear off.

programme.title: Gehri Chaal
programme.desc: Shekhar threatens to expose Ratan's secret if he does not help him in a heist. A desperate Ratan assists Shekhar, but ends up becoming the prime suspect.

programme.title: Man Ki Aankhen
programme.desc: Rajesh is in love with his teacher's daughter and marries her in secret as he fears the wrath of his dowry-seeking mother. He hopes his mother will accept his new wife.

programme.title: Zakhmee
programme.desc: Anand is arrested for his partner's murder on his wedding night. His brothers kidnap a judge's daughter to save him, setting off a chain of tragic events.

programme.title: Lahuke Do Rang
programme.desc: Inspector Raj Singh's father died for gold. Years later he locates them but also finds that he has a stepbrother Suraj who works for Shankar now known as Devi Dayal.

programme.title: Yahaan
programme.desc: In a territory of Kashmir, a Muslim woman falls in love with a Hindu man. Their love and desire for marriage, is considered as the greatest sin according to those wrapped up in the Kashmiri conflict.

programme.title: Dooriyan
programme.desc: A married couple struggles to balance their personal and professional life which causes them to separate and it affects their child.

programme.title: Jabardast Jodi
programme.desc: Two men are in love with a beautiful woman residing in their neighborhood. They desperately try to win her over in various ways.

programme.title: Shreeman Aashique
programme.desc: Vishwamitra, the founder of a group that dissuades marriages, and his follower, Dushant, fall in love with Shakuntala, who likes Dushant. But Vishwamitra creates misunderstandings between the two.

programme.title: Aradhana
programme.desc: Musical hit romantic drama tells the story of a pure hearted women, her motherhood and the sacrifices she endures over her lifetime. Starring Rajesh Khanna and Sharmila Tagore.

programme.title: Anjane Mein
programme.desc: Raja, a young boy, is separated from his parents in a train accident and taken in by a circus troupe. Years later, when an evil man hatches a heist, it is up to Raja to stop him.

programme.title: Bewafai

programme.title: Apne Paraye
programme.desc: This is a story of two lawyer brothers, their half brother, their wives and children.

programme.title: Bhajan

programme.title: Seva Ganga - Sadhu Kailash Manav
programme.desc: Narayan Seva Sansthan is, today, one of the largest organisations committed to totally free services for the poor, people with disabilities and, in particular, people who have had polio.

programme.title: Yog Rishi Swami Ramdevji
programme.desc: Swami Ramdevji Maharaj, one of the world's leading, most popular and highly result-oriented Yogacharya, has become a household name owing to his ability to simplify yoga techniques for the masses.

programme.title: Ayurved Evam Jeevan Darshan
programme.desc: Programme based on ancient Indian medicinal system of Ayurveda. Acharaji recommends lifestyle and eating habits that one can integrate into their daily lives for healthy happy living.

programme.title: Bhajan
programme.desc: Devotional songs/music.

programme.title: Pujya Deepakbhai
programme.desc: With the ever present gentle smile on his face, in individual interaction or amidst large numbers of seekers in satsang, Pujya Deepakbhai is resolving the individual and personal questions of all.

programme.title: Aastha Special
programme.desc: Live Special Telecast of Katha by revered saints and gurus from India.

programme.title: Wafadaar
programme.desc: Chanda's parents disapprove of her boyfriend Ranga and want her to marry Prasad. Ranga is accused of having an affair with Sita. Chanda faces turmoil in her life.

programme.title: Zindagi Gulzar Hai
programme.desc: Kashaf, a young woman raised by a single mother, faces a lot of class and gender bias while growing up. However, her life turns around when she meets Zaroon in college.

programme.title: Prithipal Singh...A Story
programme.desc: Disappointed with his Olympic bronze medal, Prithipal Singh quits hockey and joins a university. However, things get worse for him when he is accused of murdering a student.

programme.title: Kaise Kahoon Ke...Pyaar Hai
programme.desc: Karan, a burglar, wishes to permanently leave his profession when he falls in love with Priya. They decide to get married, but Karan finds out that he has cancer.

programme.title: Insaniyat
programme.desc: In order to combat terrorism, Inspector Amar has to convince two local crime lords, divided by religion, to work together. He also learns that being an honest cop has its own price.

programme.title: Sultanat
programme.desc: Sultan, a brave warrior, tries to win the affections of Yasmin, a beautiful woman. However, his life turns upside-down when his father is killed by a general who he then swears revenge against.

programme.title: 16 December
programme.desc: Four Indian Revenue Service officers are assigned to intercept and arrest a group of Pakistani terrorists. The terrorists plot to detonate a nuclear bomb in New Delhi and the IRS must stop them.

programme.title: 100 Days of Love
programme.desc: Despite their strained history as children, a columnist falls in love with his schoolmate when they meet after years. Just as he decides to win her heart, he learns that she is engaged to another man.

programme.title: Marshal
programme.desc: A young man puts his life on the line to investigate a hospital run by a crime syndicate that performs various unethical procedures on helpless patients.

programme.title: Daring Ashique
programme.desc: Cheenu, a studious boy, and Lakshmi, the village landlord's daughter, study in the same college and fall for each other. However, her brother-in-law covets her and poses problems for the couple.

programme.title: Johny I Love You
programme.desc: Suraj Singh, a former bandit, relocates to a small hillside after the death of his wife, Savitri. He changes his son Raju's name to Johny to save him from the wrath of his former partner.

programme.title: Ram Balram
programme.desc: Jagatpal raises his nephews, Ram and Balram, after killing their parents. He hatches an evil plan to push Ram into the world of smuggling and earn money, but the brothers unite to take him down.

programme.title: Baadshah
programme.desc: Raj, a small-time private detective who is desperate for a big break, gets drawn into a political conspiracy when he is hired to rescue a hostage.

programme.title: Ajab Gazabb Love
programme.desc: Rajveer, a rich man, falls in love with Madhuri. However, he soon realises that she detests affluent people and in order to win her heart, he, along with his family, pretends to be poor.

programme.title: Khel
programme.desc: Three fraudsters trick a rich elderly woman, Sulakshana, who is desperately looking for her long-lost grandchild, in order to acquire her estate and property.

programme.title: Viduthalai Part 1
programme.desc: A policeman is conflicted between duty and morality when his department begins a brutal campaign to capture a local activist.

programme.title: Ohm Shanti Oshaana
programme.desc: Pooja Mathew, a spirited young girl, dreams about marrying only for love. Thus, she stops at nothing to impress Giri, who saved her once from a group of unruly men.

programme.title: Khatarnak Khel
programme.desc: A young girl loses her parents in an accident due to illegal bike racers in Chennai. She soon sets out to exact revenge on the racer responsible for her parents' death.

programme.title: Anari Ishq
programme.desc: Rama, a simpleton, is appointed as the bodyguard of Rajnandini, a rich girl. She soon falls in love with him but her brothers' violent nature gets in the way of her uniting with Rama.

programme.title: Naya Kadam
programme.desc: In a village ruled by Madhukar and Jaggu, who deprive the people of education so they can easily oppress them, Ramu manages to educate himself secretly with the help of a school teacher.

programme.title: Kahani Kismat Ki
programme.desc: A reformed man tries to make an honest living for himself and his family after his jail term. His life takes an ugly turn when a woman claims him to be her husband and he is also framed for murder.

programme.title: Juaari
programme.desc: Vijay, a young man, resorts to gambling in order to free his lover, Anita, who is held captive by Sanga. He soon runs out of luck when he gets arrested.

programme.title: Chak De Phatte Hockey Ke..
programme.desc: Prabhakaran, a former hockey player, helps a local team save their ground by training them to win a match against the Pondicherry team. However, a corrupt politician has his eyes set on the ground.

programme.title: Karishma Kudrat Ka
programme.desc: Widower Vijay lives in a village with his family. He unwittingly makes an enemy in Lala and a bandit, Bhagad, who conspire and throw him out of the village. But Vijay soon returns as a changed man.

programme.title: Blue Oranges
programme.desc: When a wealthy alcoholic turns up dead, Detective Nilesh investigates the murder by interrogating various suspects that include her former lover, a spoilt brat and the commissioner's brother.

programme.title: Main Hun Ziddi
programme.desc: Bollywood action starring Prajwal Devaraj, 2013.

programme.title: Mithya
programme.desc: Albert Samson, a successful architect, and Alice are leading an unhappy married life because of Samson's ambitious and egoistic nature. Hilda Varghese enters Samson's life and changes it completely.

programme.title: Saajan Ki Saheli
programme.desc: Kunti abandons her baby in order to lead a lavish life and marries a rich man. Years later, she realises that her husband is indulging in an affair and is shocked to find out the truth about the girl.

programme.title: Nazar Ke Samne
programme.desc: Jai, an unemployed drunk, gives false testimony that puts an innocent man in jail for murder. However, he later relents and tries to exonerate him by searching for the real killer.

programme.title: Powerfull Yoddha
programme.desc: Chandu is very passionate about kickboxing and his life revolves around his mother and his girlfriend. His life is shattered when his dying mother asks him to meet his estranged father Raghuveer.

programme.title: Mera Karam Mera Dharam
programme.desc: Ajay, a businessman, provides funds to Sarjuprasad to develop his hometown. When he learns that the money has been misappropriated by Sarjuprasad, he resolves to set things right.

programme.desc: A powerful gangster named Don (Amitabh Bachchan) flees the cops and is killed during a showdown with Officer D'Silva (Iftekhar). programme.title: Travel in Style S2 - "ASCOT & DUBAI"

programme.title: Travel in Style S2 - "SICILY & LOS ANGELES"

programme.title: Travel in Style S2 - "ST. PETERSBURG & LONDON"
programme.desc: This episode takes our team east to Russia to discover its former capital \u2013 the magical city of St Petersburg. Well next off our lucky crew head to England to visit the Dorchester hotel in London.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S2 - "Income for a Rainy Day (Part 2)"
programme.desc: Vezi works in the music industry, so Inez lines up some special surprises to wow her clients! This episode has special guest appearances by designer and rockstar Sergio Galli of Platinum Blonde, and musicians Amy Sky and Marc Jordan.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S2 - "Tricky Choice (Part 1)"
programme.desc: Laura and Steven are a couple with an expanding family, and are ready to take the next steps in home ownership. They want a large plot of land for their young children to run around, and a spacious home that reflects this new phase of their life.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S2 - "Tricky Choice (Part 2)"
programme.desc: Steve Bailey is the man for the job, and with such great homes to choose from, Laura and Steve will be hard pressed to pick just one!

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "Fishing Charter"
programme.desc: The couple test their skills running a fishing charter. How will two bed & breakfasters in France cope with their biggest challenge? On the Costa Blanca, a family pulls together to try and rescue their Spanish dream.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "Pop-Up"
programme.desc: The vineyard owners open a pop up restaurant in a stunning location. Two B&B hosts an event in a bid to boost takings. In Spain, a wannabe fishing captain has to learn the ropes.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "Observatory"
programme.desc: It\u2019s decision time for a couple hoping to run a fishing charter business. How will two B&B cope with some tricky customers? And with their first guests now booked in, will an observatory business France please it\u2019s punters?

programme.title: Australia's Amazing Homes S1 - "Vintage Twist"
programme.desc: Johanna and Pete explore a collection of Australian vintage homes that have been masterfully renovated to meet the needs of modern living without destroying the past.

programme.title: Australia's Amazing Homes S1 - "Inventive Architecture"
programme.desc: Explore a collection of houses that have one thing in common - the designers have come up with inventive ideas and radical approaches to solving everyday design issues. It's both clever and inspiring with plenty of take home tips for the home renovator.

programme.title: Australia's Amazing Homes S1 - "Little Gems"
programme.desc: Modern city living has it challenges mostly around space. Johanna and Pete look at homes that make the most out of the space they have. These little gems may change the way you think about living in small spaces.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1 - "Paris & Barcelona"
programme.desc: Bones introduce his trademark trickery to people in Paris and Barcelona, performing mind reading and an attempt to escape a straitjacket while breakdancing.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1 - "London"
programme.desc: In this episode Bones is back in his home city, London where he stuns locals with his mind reading, card trickery and disappearing skills.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1 - "South Korea - Night"
programme.desc: Bones is in Seoul, South Korea. He explores the city by night and performs a mixture of magic tricks, including a vanishing trick, coin tricks and card tricks.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show S1 - "Chiang Mai - Eze"
programme.desc: From Asia to Europe this episode explore the cultures and magnificent architecture in Chiang Mai and Eze in the South of France.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show S1 - "Ice Hotel, Sweden - Bangkok"
programme.desc: From the hustle and bustle of Bangkok to the freezing temperatures of the Ice Hotel in Sweden, this episode is all about polar opposites, fire and ice.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show S1 - "St Tropez - St Lucia"
programme.desc: Romantic Caribbean Islands and sleeping fishing villages turned European jet set resorts, this episode travels from St Lucia to St Tropez.

programme.title: Big Little Footprints S1 - "City Escape - Miami"
programme.desc: To educate our children about the profound impact of travel we travel to Miami, Florida. We'll learn about the area's colorful history, taste test its cuisine, learn Latin dancing and experience an epic adventure through the everglades.

programme.title: Big Little Footprints S1 - "Eco-Explore Your Backyard - California Coast to Santa Barbara"
programme.desc: In this episode we remind viewers just how much you can find when exploring your own backyard by road tripping the California Coast to Santa Barbara! Swapping TV time to chats around the campfire and an exciting encounter with sea lions.

programme.title: Big Little Footprints S1 - "Big Resort, Big Heart - Atlantis Bahamas"
programme.desc: If the Atlantis Bahamas isn\u2019t on your family's bucket list - it should be! We\u2019ll show you why as each family member ticks off their dream adventure that also gives back. Proving this big resort has an even bigger heart.

programme.title: Journeys in India S1 - "Agra and Its Environs"
programme.desc: Agra is home to India\u2019s most recognizable monument\u2014the Taj Mahal. We tour the Agra Fort and learn its role in the incredible history behind the Taj Mahal\u2019s construction.

programme.title: Journeys in India S1 - "The Land of Rudyard Kipling: Kanha & Bandhavgarh National Parks"
programme.desc: With classic tales as The Jungle Book to his credit, Rudyard Kipling brought India to life for many readers around the world. In this episode, Bill steps back into Kipling\u2019s wild world while exploring Kanha and Bandhavgarh National Parks.

programme.title: Journeys in India S1 - "Bangalore and Ooty"
programme.desc: Bangalore is a city with many names: the Garden City, the Pub City, the Fashion Capital the list goes on. Follow Bill as he journeys through this city of contrasts and touches on its many faces.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S2 - "We Bought a Resort (Part 1)"
programme.desc: Sofie heads back to Belize to help husband and wife team Rachel and Ben size up some properties. Along with their investors, the couple are looking to purchase a resort on the island of Ambergris Caye that will provide the most bang for their buck.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3 - "India"
programme.desc: Jonathan begins a quest to find an extreme type of holy man reputed to eat human flesh and commit other blatant acts of embracing taboos in a strange path to nirvana.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3 - "India Part 2"
programme.desc: In a country where anything can be found, Jonathan is unsurprising to find women in different roles and status, but the extremes are shockingly diverse and unexpected.

programme.title: Karena and Kasey’s Foreign Flavours S1 - "Japan"
programme.desc: The duo hits Tokyo\u2019s food mecca for Michelin-starred sushi and ramen, ending their journey by cooking for a high-stakes charity auction.

programme.title: Karena and Kasey’s Foreign Flavours S1 - "New Caledonia"
programme.desc: In their final stop, Karena and Kasey blend Pacific produce with French techniques, visiting the Isle of Pines to cook for savvy local foodies.

programme.title: Sweet Planet S1 - "Sweet After Bitter"
programme.desc: From Teochew sweetrice cakes in China, sugarcane in India, to chocolate in Ivory Coast, this episode tells the story of how humans pursue and obtain sweetness, and how sweetness provides comfort and warmth to humanity.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S2 - "Hawaii"
programme.desc: Chris travels to Hawaii\u2019s Big Island, hikes to the heart of a volcano and takes a night dive that brings him face to face with dozens of giant manta rays.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S2 - "Kangaroo Island"
programme.desc: Chris takes a photo challenge on beautiful Kangaroo Island and finds himself swimming in some unusual company.

programme.title: Taste of France S1 - "Matthieu Dupuis Baumal – Chateau de la Gaude"
programme.desc: In this program we\u2019ll explore the story of the skilled Chef Matthieu Dupuis Baumal, his style of cooking and how he took his team to greatness in only a couple of months! We\u2019ll also visit one of the best olive oil producers in the world.

programme.title: Taste of France S1 - "Amandine Chaignot – Pouliche"
programme.desc: In this program Amandine Chaignot demonstrates the extent of her talent, serving refined vegetarian-focused cuisine. We\u2019ll get to know her secrets for stimulating flavors and the principles behind her raw, refined French cuisine.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S6 - "Milwaukee"
programme.desc: Denella experiences Milwaukee\u2013where fresh meets fearless every day.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Nicosia"
programme.desc: Josh is in Cyprus for a local exploring adventure across the island on a roadtrip from Nicosia to an abandoned amusement park, an asbestos mine and a shipwreck.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "New Orleans"
programme.desc: Cody is with Lexi Limitless in the \u2018Big Easy\u2019 to explore New Orleans, visiting an abandoned Charity Hospital before meeting Brutus, the giant alligator.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Yerevan"
programme.desc: Josh goes local exploring in Armenia and its capital Yerevan, visiting some amazing abandoned Soviet buildings, a knitting factory and a luxurious hotel.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S1 - "KINGFISH + DEER HUNTING"
programme.desc: In this episode, Piri goes deep sea fishing in Tokomaru Bay. Plus a father and son duo take Piri deer stalking.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S2 - "Dannevirke / Norsewood"
programme.desc: Piri is in Manawatu in search of kina and paua. He goes rabbit shooting with the local \u201CRuahine Hunter\u201D in Norsewood.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S2 - "Hokianga"
programme.desc: Piri goes fishing for Snapper in Mitimiti, and has a go at drag-netting flounder in Whirinaki.

programme.title: Epic Trails S2 - "Peak District & Derbyshire"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson heads to the Peak District in England, to tackle the 268-mile Pennine Way\u2014Britain\u2019s oldest and most challenging National Trail.

programme.title: Epic Trails S2 - "Juneau, Alaska"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson heads deep into the backcountry to explore the mountains, glaciers and wildlife around Alaska\u2019s capital city of Juneau.

programme.title: Epic Trails S2 - "Jämtland, Sweden"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson heads 63 degrees north to J\u00E4mtland, Sweden, where he discovers a wild culture and breathtaking wilderness trails.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Brazil’s Pantanal"
programme.desc: There may be no place on earth so rich in wildlife as Brazil\u2019s Pantanal. In this Quest, Bill is going to track some of the rainforest creatures he\u2019s always wanted to see.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Cultural Rwanda"
programme.desc: They say time heals all wounds, but can it heal the most horrific of all\u2014genocide. On this Quest, Bill returns to Rwanda to see the post-war healing happening in this small, but globally significant country.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Australia Top to Bottom"
programme.desc: Australia is a giant country with diverse ecosystems that make it one of the most interesting in the world. This episode of Travel Quest explores the north and far south of this country\u2026the world\u2019s biggest \u201Cisland\u201D.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3 - "Italy"
programme.desc: Italy in the summertime is as touristy as it gets... can Jonathan still find the road less traveled?

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3 - "Italy Part 2"
programme.desc: \"In stunning Lago di Garda Jonathan attempts to pull off a paragliding maneuver which almost put him in a wet grave last summer. Nearby, in the city of Bolzano, he joins a crack helicopter rescue force to run rescue drills, but a real emergency might sink his mission. When it's time to leave, our host decides to take a one-of-a-kind white knuckle route over the majestic Dolomite mountains and all the way up to switzerland to visit a town that revolves, clockwise, around a single purpose. \".

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3 - "Belgium"
programme.desc: In a country not renown for excitement, something huge is about to happen. Jonathan digs around the Flanders exploring western Europe's least appreciated region.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S2 - "Wildest Swimming"
programme.desc: Chris shares his wildest swimming adventures, from swimming with hump back whales, to racing with wild dolphins!

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S2 - "Mother's Day"
programme.desc: It\u2019s Mother\u2019s Day. But with adventures ranging from trapeze walking to jetpack flying, it might not be quite what you\u2019d expect.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S2 - "Coober Pedy"
programme.desc: Chris is going underground; from the caves of Coober Pedy to accommodation with a difference in the Blue mountains.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Ryozenji Temple Shikoku, Japan"
programme.desc: In this episode the brothers shun the more famous areas, Tokyo and Kyoto, and head to the isolated, ancient island of Shikoku. Their route is the ancient 88 Temple Zen pilgrimage circuit.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Cape Breton Island, Canada"
programme.desc: By pick-up truck, the brothers route is the culturally and geographically rich island of Cape Breton and the Cabot Trail. Lobster fishing, hooking, moose sightings, Bingo, Scottish ceilidhs, Mi'kmaq drum session, it's all happening in this episode.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Volcan Madera, Nicaragua"
programme.desc: The brothers attain their goal of riding motorcycles to the heart of Nicaragua, through the jungle to the isolated beaches of the Pacific coast and back inland: through Spanish-colonial towns, local villages and the huge volcanic island of Ometepe.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S2 - "Gisborne"
programme.desc: Piri dives for Kina in Gisborne, and faces his fear of stingrays. Plus, he goes on a voyage on waka Tairawhiti, then visits Te Poho o Rawiri Marae.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S2 - "Manawatu / Whanganui"
programme.desc: Piri goes in search of the illusive Samba deer near Marton. Plus a journey up the Whanganui River sees him chasing wild pigs.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S2 - "Whangarei"
programme.desc: Piri tries his hand at snapper fishing from a kayak, goes scallop diving and attempts to out run a National Waka Ama champion.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "On the Edge in Gans Bay"
programme.desc: While Xander travels to the fishing town of Gansbaai to experience the joys, and horrors, of the sea, Adam experiences a few frights of his own back at home.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "The Valley of Desolation"
programme.desc: Xander and his team travel to Graaff-Reinet, one of the oldest towns in South Africa, to enjoy food, history, and nature, while Adam spends the day searching for fossils in his hometown.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "The Dullstroom Highlands"
programme.desc: Xander and his team drive eleven hours to Dullstroom, a quaint town where fishing and drinking prevails. Across the pond, Adam\u2019s desire to participate with Xander and his crew takes him all the way to the grocery store.

programme.title: Car & Country Quest S1 - "Deepak's India"
programme.desc: Deepak, Ashique, and Freddie explore South Kerala. They experience Kalaripayattu martial arts, ride Royal Enfields through scenic landscapes, enjoy a jungle cruise, taste local toddy and cuisine, and compete in a thrilling snake boat race.

programme.title: Car & Country Quest S1 - "Ashique's India"
programme.desc: Ashique leads an adventure through North Kerala, driving Ferraris and Lamborghinis, as well as experiencing a fascinating train ride across the Indian region. The trio enjoys wildlife, a market visit, a mountain camping trip, a night safari, traditional dance, and a thrilling race.

programme.title: Foodwise S2 - "Kunming"
programme.desc: Join host Tianran He in Kunming, the capital of Yunnan province in southwest China. Named the Spring City for its perennially good weather, Kunming is one of China's most ethnically diverse cities, something that's reflected in its food.

programme.title: Foodwise S2 - "The Taste of Home"
programme.desc: Eva rediscovers her love for a classic century-old dish in her hometown Vienna. Meanwhile, Beijing's charming autumn season sets Tianran back in time as he rediscovers flavors from his childhood.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S1 - "Rome: What are the tourists missing out on?"
programme.desc: Italy is a vacationer\u2019s paradise. The food, the people, the sights and sounds, the history! But are the tourists doing it right when it comes to the trying out authentic food in Rome? Liesel embarks on a mission to explore the street food of the city. With the help of her food journalist buddy, Saverio de Luca, Liesel sifts through pasticceri, food festivals, touristed hotspots, all in an effort to understand real Roman food.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S1 - "Emlia Romagna: What’s the food like?"
programme.desc: The region of Emilia Romagna is lush with gentle rolling hills where time honored ingredients like truffles, olives, and vast vineyards can be found. But this region is usually overshadowed by it\u2019s more famous neighboring cities, Florence and Venice. To understand the food of this region, Liesel explores the quaint sea-side town of Rimini and the hugely impressive Bologna. It's a tale of discovering local foodie passion that allows Liesel to hunt for truffles and try her hand in making her own gelato, a the world\u2019s only Gelato University!

programme.title: Breaking Beyond S1 - "Goma, Congo"
programme.desc: Bboy Junior is going back where he was born, The Democratic Republic of Congo. World champion Shigekix will join him, visiting Africa for the first time. Together they will explore the dance culture in the city of Goma.

programme.title: Breaking Beyond S1 - "Sao Paulo, Brazil"
programme.desc: Russian Bgirl Kastet is visiting Sao Paulo, the home of Bboy Neguin. Together they will explore the dance, breaking and hip hop culture in the streets of Sao Paulo. Meeting up with legends and learning Capoeira, Jiu Jitsu and Passinho.

programme.title: Inside the Box with Jack Stein S1 - "Zagreb"
programme.desc: In landlocked Zagreb, Jack swaps potatoes for sauerkraut to serve a localized fish and chips to curious locals and government officials.

programme.title: Inside the Box with Jack Stein S1 - "Darwin"
programme.desc: With no shrimp in Darwin, Jack pivots to mudcrab and crocodile meat to reinvent his Cornwall recipe for a tropical Australian crowd.

programme.title: A Taste of Travel S4 - "Florence, Los Angeles"
programme.desc: Lynton explores the iconic Coral Coast of Fiji. Carolyne visits the wonders of Florence. Scotty continues his journey through South Africa and Susannah discovers a slightly more sinister side of Los Angeles.

programme.title: Chasing Monsters: El Nino S1 - "Mavericks"
programme.desc: Big wave surfing\u2019s elite break routines and converge to ride an unforgettable swell at Mavericks.

programme.title: Chasing Monsters: El Nino S1 - "The Eddie"
programme.desc: The world\u2019s elite big wave surfers revel in the biggest most powerful Waimea Bay surf conditions to ever grace the Eddie Aikau Contest.

programme.title: Chasing Monsters: El Nino S1 - "Maui"
programme.desc: Tyler Larronde beats the odds to execute a seamless barrel at the legendary big wave known as Mavericks.

programme.title: My Van Life S1 - "Arizona"
programme.desc: Lisa spontaneously joins a sober dance party on a mountain top in Sedona, and meets spiritual Van Lifers who have dramatically changed their entire existence, including former NFL player Joe Hawley, and a transformative breathwork practitioner.

programme.title: My Van Life S1 - "Utah"
programme.desc: Lisa heads to Utah, the ultimate playground for Van Life adrenaline junkies: aka Dirt Bags. Base jumper Derrick shows that by confronting death, it helps us appreciate life. We meet a solo female traveler who challenges Lisa by taking her bouldering.

programme.title: My Van Life S1 - "Nevada"
programme.desc: Lisa meets off-grid desert nomads turning to this lifestyle out of necessity rather than choice. Van Life rebels rule in Slab City, while in Nevada, Bob Wells - the godfather of Van Life - helps thousands turn to nomadic life when in dire straits.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S2 - "Attempting to narrowboat the longest canal aqueduct in the UK"
programme.desc: Michael steers across the UK's highest and longest canal aqueduct, exploring narrow waterways and a rare horse-pulled boat.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S2 - "Attempting to narrowboat the deepest canal lock in the UK"
programme.desc: The narrowboat journey faces its toughest test yet: navigating the deepest lock in the network while managing the daily difficulties of water life.

programme.title: A Simple Path S1 - "Swakopmund"
programme.desc: Amidst the vast desert, we discover handmade leather shoes, the yellow bus on the beach, Kalahari truffles, the power of gemstones, keepers of the desert elephants and a skate ramp in the middle of the dunes.

programme.title: A Simple Path S1 - "Nairobi"
programme.desc: Uhuru Park is the nucleus for skateboarders in Gaborone. We meet street Keedz turning their lives around, a local animator, the producer of Sighkick Mag and learn how to make homemade trucks and sign language at Pallet Caf\u00E9.

programme.title: A Simple Path S2 - "Jakarta"
programme.desc: Jakarta, urban meets jungle. The yellow brick road, shiny shoes at Survive Skate shop, 24\/7 under the bridge. Road trip to Bandung, a mosque session, Nasi Padang Every Day, Bhang records, live with Sigit, motion graphics and self-expression.

programme.title: Street Art Challenge S1 - "Athens"
programme.desc: Two American street artists try to turn a school into a piece of art. Seems impossible, but this duo turns out to be a real American Dream Team.

programme.title: Street Art Challenge S1 - "Bangalore"
programme.desc: Two worlds collide in one of the busiest cities in the world when Mexico\u2019s most famous street artist is meeting his equivalent on their home turf in India.

programme.title: Street Art Challenge S1 - "Rotterdam"
programme.desc: Two European street artists are teaming up in the Netherlands for the ultimate Street Art Challenge but Mother Nature seems to be doing everything to ruin it.

programme.title: Capturing Winter S1 - "Martin Bochatay and Arthur Maneint"
programme.desc: Martin and Arthur are two of the world\u2019s best FPV drone pilots. Now the duo team up with pro skier and Olympic medalist, Kevin Rolland, for a unique project ; mount a cinema camera on a racing drone and attempt to film some never-before-seen action.

programme.title: Capturing Winter S1 - "Guido Perrini & Geraldine Fasnacht"
programme.desc: Cinematographer Guido Perrini has created many of the most revered ski and snowboard films. We follow him and multi-talented athlete G\u00E9raldine Fasnacht on a snowboarding and base jumping adventure in some of the most stunning peaks in the Swiss Alps.

programme.title: Capturing Winter S1 - "Layla Kerley & Bruno Compagnet"
programme.desc: Layla Kerley is a self-taught adventure photographer and one of the few females in her field. Together with Bruno Compagnet, co-founder of freeski brand Blackcrows, they plan to traverse one of the last wildernesses in Europe: the Italian Dolomites.

programme.title: Journey Within S1 - "LA"
programme.desc: In LA, we hike with wolfs, Ayurveda insights with Jay and a delicious meal from Karla. Marilia takes an adventurous leap from an airplane, showing the freedom in extreme sports.Tracy showcases the joy of pursuing passions with WCMX at the skate park.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S1 - "Newfoundland"
programme.desc: Following Newfoundland\u2019s rail history, Michael explores cod fishing, grape-free wine, and meadow cliffs by ATV.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S1 - "Nova Scotia"
programme.desc: Exploring Canada\u2019s railway roots, Michael discovers Nova Scotia through Indigenous dance, log rolling with a champion, and surfing iconic waves.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S1 - "New Brunswick"
programme.desc: Michael explores New Brunswick by land, sea, and air. He traverses historic bridges and scenic coasts before taking to the skies.

programme.title: City Beats S1 - "Berlin"
programme.desc: DJ and house music producer Carly Foxx journeys Berlin, one of the worlds undisputed techno capitals, and discovers the sound of freedom buried in its history.

programme.title: City Beats S1 - "Ibiza"
programme.desc: DJ-producer Carly Foxx travels to the clubbing capital of the world to inspire her music track and discovers Ibiza\u2019s alternative spiritual side.

programme.title: City Beats S1 - "Europe"
programme.desc: DJ and house music producer Carly Foxx looks back at her journey to the music dance capitals of Europe to inspire her final track.

programme.title: Breaking Beyond S1 - "Las Vegas, USA"
programme.desc: Brazilian Bboy Neguin is visiting his friend Bboy Ronnie in his hometown Las Vegas. Ronnie istaking Neguin to meet all the different artists and dancers who are able to make a living inVegas by doing what they love most: performing on stage.

programme.title: Breaking Beyond S1 - "Tokyo, Japan"
programme.desc: Vegas Bboy Ronnie is traveling to Japan to visit Bboy Shigekix in his hometown Tokyo. Shigekix will take Ronnie on an exciting Journey to show the Japanese culture and it's unique style of breaking and hip-hop.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S2 - "We Bought a Resort (Part 2)"
programme.desc: Each with a big personality of their own, it becomes clear this couple is not going to see eye to eye on what they want. Luckily for them, Sofie is a pro at mediating conflicts when it comes to real estate.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S3 - "Net Zero"
programme.desc: Julie and James are looking for a new home to raise their two boys. James is in the tech industry and would love an energy efficient home. Julie has her own dance studio and can't wait to get back to work after giving birth to her second son.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3 - "England"
programme.desc: Jonathan plunges into London for an urban adventure, exploring the subcultures of the diverse city. A trip that will include stripping for naked poetry, spraying bars with grime rappers, and viewing burlesque at it\u2019s roots.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3 - "England Part 2"
programme.desc: Jonathan travels across the pond to the land of his ancestors to look into the British isles homegrown beliefs, legends, and sports in a trip that begins with a vampire lurking in a cemetery and ends with zombie apocalypse.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "Dordogne"
programme.desc: A family rushes to open a bar while awaiting bank approval. New B&B owners in the Dordogne welcome their first guests. A novice fisherman takes on his first trip in Spain.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "Cape Verde"
programme.desc: An expat fisherman scores a big catch in Cape Verde, while another struggles in Spain. A French B&B receives its first review, and a boutique hotel launches a wedding business.

programme.title: The Delinquent Gourmet S1 - "Sardinia"
programme.desc: Rodney is in Sardinia, Italy, where he finds culinary inspiration around every corner. High in the Sardinian hills, his hosts prepare their specialty - roasted suckling pig. After sitting down to an outdoor family meal (where even the dog helps himself!), Rodney samples a myrtle-flavored liquor before dancing with his gentlemen hosts.

programme.title: The Streets S1 - "Detroit"
programme.desc: Punk rocker Jon-Mikal formed his band The Idiot Kids as a way to deal with his sexuality. After coming out to his family at 21, he uses writing and his stage performance as a form of therapy.

programme.title: Khanh Ong's Wild Food S1 - "Nywaigi Country"
programme.desc: Chef Khanh Ong journeys to Australia\u2019s tropical Far North Queensland to discover the culinary secrets of the Nywaigi people, the traditional owners of the land. In this episode he learns to cook Magpie Goose with Nywaigi Man Buddy Cassidy.

programme.title: Khanh Ong's Wild Food S1 - "Port Lincoln, SA"
programme.desc: Chef Khanh Ong Journeys to the rugged coastal town of Port Lincoln, in South Australia to unlock the secrets of the local seafood. From locals, he learns how to trawl for wild prawns, harvest oysters and forages for unique coastal ingredients.

programme.title: Khanh Ong's Wild Food S1 - "Cairns, QLD"
programme.desc: Chef Khanh Ong travels to Cairns, Australia where he embarks on an adventure to the rainforests of Mission Beach. Learning from locals, he learns how to hunt mud crabs with a spear on the traditional fishing grounds of the Kuku Yalanji people.

programme.title: The Streets S1 - "New York"
programme.desc: Rapper Shiniqua, aka Pretty Little Monster, juggles motherhood while trying to avoid the trappings of Instagram fame. Her passion is writing rap lyrics and always tries to keep it real.

programme.title: Paradise Kitchen Bali S1 - "Chocolate"
programme.desc: Indulge in Lauren's exploration of the chocolate world as she uncovers its unique types and characteristics. From savory chocolate salsa to raw vegan cake, her mix of sweet and savory recipes leaves a lasting appreciation for this beloved ingredient.

programme.title: Foodwise S2 - "Shaoxing"
programme.desc: Join host Tianran He in the historic water town of Shaoxing, famed for its yellow wine. Traversing its canals by boat, Tianran discovers why it's said there are 10,000 bridges in Shaoxing.

programme.title: Foodwise S2 - "Haikou"
programme.desc: Welcome to Haikou, also known as the Coconut City! Join Tianran experiencing the culinary culture and urban character of this tropical paradise. From light and sweet coconut chicken hotpot to refreshing herbal desserts and spicy rice soup.

programme.title: Foodwise S2 - "Hainan's Four Famous Dishes"
programme.desc: The stunning east coast of Hainan in southeast China, attract numerous visitors to travel. Hainan\u2019s four famous dishes are chicken, duck, goat and crab.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S1 - "Mexico: Tequila: Does it need to come from certain regions of Mexico?"
programme.desc: In the land of tequila, Liesel gets the skinny on the premium export of Jalisco, blue agave tequila. From harvesting agave with the legendary jimadores, to understanding the process of distillation, Liesel is on the hunt to appreciate and understand the production requirements of this spirit that makes it what it is. Are they worth it only if they\u2019re from Jalisco or can they be made somewhere else for cheaper and better..? Liesel finds out!

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S1 - "Los Angeles: Food trucks: are they any good?"
programme.desc: It\u2019s a well known fact that Los Angeles is the trendsetter for entertainment, fashion, and outlandish celebrity exploits. But is it the same story with the food? Liesel explores the food truck bubble to figure out what started the craze, why it's so popular, and more importantly, is the food any good?

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S1 - "Indonesia - Balinese cuisine: what is it all about?"
programme.desc: Balinese cuisine is considered to be extremely complex. Different than what you find in the rest of Indonesia, Bali is further influenced by the major influx of Western tourism. Have the locals kept their traditions and cooking methods strong against the wave of tourism, or have they been catered to suit the palates of foreigners? Liesel heads to the ultimate getaway paradise island, sifts through all the yoga retreats, surfer shacks, and coffee plantations all in an effort to find iconic food - as well as track down the current foodie trend of the island.

programme.title: Andy & Ben Eat the World S1 - "Barcelona and Beyond"
programme.desc: In Spain, Andy and Ben explore La Boqueria Market, ride a gourmet food bus, hunt for wild mushrooms, and visit a farmhouse to cure sausages.

programme.title: Andy & Ben Eat the World S1 - "Rocks, Wine, and Paella"
programme.desc: The boys try ancient Basque rock lifting, stomp wine grapes with their feet, taste local delicacies, and learn the fine art of carving jam\u00F3n.

programme.title: Andy & Ben Eat the World S1 - "Flamenco to Portugal"
programme.desc: After attempting flamenco dancing, the lads cross into Portugal, cooking with top chef Jos\u00E9 Avillez before catching fresh snapper in the Algarve.

programme.title: Karena and Kasey’s Foreign Flavours S1 - "Korea"
programme.desc: Karena and Kasey land in Seoul to master Korean BBQ, study with a Kimchi Master, and cook Kiwi-Korean fusion for a panel of elite local foodies.

programme.title: Karena and Kasey’s Foreign Flavours S1 - "Italy"
programme.desc: Karena and Kasey master Roman pasta and tripe while honoring their M\u0101ori heritage and fallen soldiers at the historic Monte Cassino battlegrounds.

programme.title: Karena and Kasey’s Foreign Flavours S1 - "India"
programme.desc: Karena and Kasey face a sensory explosion in Old Delhi's streets, feed thousands at a Sikh temple, and prep appetizers for a massive Indian wedding.

programme.desc: Rustic regional dishes and northern Italian villages entice Ash, who later prepares a feast for comedian Nazeem Hussain.

programme.desc: Sipping Bellini cocktails in Harry\u2019s Bar and learning the art of glass blowing in Venice. While in London its afternoon tea at the resplendent Dorchester Hotel and a helicopter tour of the capital.

programme.desc: Elephant camps and bustling markets are on the agenda in Thailand\u2019s Chiang Mai district. Then it\u2019s off to the Caribbean\u2019s famous spice island, Grenada for scuba diving, volcano\u2019s and tropical rain forests.
